descriptionByLocale.it:
Posizione Scopo Il Direttore associato, Programmazione statistica fornisce leadership e competenze nel guidare lo sviluppo e il mantenimento delle capacità di programmazione statistica del CSL necessarie per soddisfare gli obblighi normativi. L'individuo lavorerà a stretto contatto con il Direttore della programmazione statistica per garantire che tutti i compiti di programmazione statistica assegnati siano gestiti fino al completamento. Lavorare a stretto contatto con gli statistici per garantire che i risultati forniti dalle risorse interne o dai fornitori esterni (CRO; fornitori FSP) siano accurati e allineati agli standard CSL. Questa persona può gestire aree terapeutiche (TA) o programmi all'interno o tra AT lavorando con il responsabile dell'AT di Statistica per garantire che tutto il lavoro richiesto nell'AT sia completato entro le tempistiche del progetto con alta qualità. Principali responsabilità e responsabilità
• Collaborare con il Direttore, Programmazione per valutare le attività imminenti e le conseguenti esigenze di risorse e garantire la consegna tempestiva e di alta qualità dei progetti assegnati. Garantire una pianificazione realistica del progetto.
• Supervisionare la consegna del CRO o gestire la programmazione interna di set di dati, output e file DDT di studi clinici e analisi integrate.
• Pianifica e guida la progettazione e l'implementazione di specifiche e programmi complessi per applicazioni progettate per analizzare e riportare dati complessi di studi clinici in formato CDISC.
• Coordinare la supervisione o la programmazione interna di analisi esplorative, analisi a supporto di pubblicazioni secondarie, risposta a richieste normative o altre richieste ad hoc.
• Guida i programmatori assegnati ai progetti assegnati e fornisce feedback ai manager di questi membri del team secondo necessità.
• In qualità di leader di progetto o programma, garantisce il rispetto del processo e della strategia di programmazione per facilitare una programmazione accurata e tempestiva.
• Testare e implementare metodi e strumenti di programmazione all'avanguardia per l'organizzazione e promuovere l'automazione della consegna, inclusa l'intelligenza artificiale. Istruzione
• Laurea in informatica, matematica, statistica o area correlata con esperienza rilevante
• Altri titoli e certificazioni considerati se commisurati alla relativa esperienza di programmazione Esperienza
• Almeno 9 anni di esperienza nella programmazione clinica e/o nella programmazione statistica, all'interno dell'ambiente CRO/farmaceutico utilizzando il software SAS.
• Comprensione completa dei processi e degli standard di programmazione clinica e/o di programmazione statistica.
• Esperienze avanzate con la programmazione statistica utilizzando il software SAS incluso lo sviluppo e l'uso di macro SAS.
• Conoscenza avanzata degli standard CDISC (CDASH, SDTM, ADaM).
• Comprovata capacità di lavorare in modo efficace sia in modo indipendente che in un contesto di squadra e di raggiungere gli obiettivi prefissati gestendo le proprie tempistiche.
• Esperienza di lavoro in team di sperimentazioni cliniche interfunzionali, multiculturali e internazionali. Competenze
• Codifica in SAS, incluso il linguaggio macro SAS
• Interesse e/o esperienza nell'espansione oltre SAS come strumento primario di distribuzione della programmazione
• Esperienza e/o passione per l'automazione di attività di programmazione di routine
• Ampia conoscenza dello sviluppo clinico e dei processi
• Forti capacità interpersonali e di comunicazione (verbali e scritte in inglese), a proprio agio con il senior management
• Capacità di lavorare in modo collaborativo in un ambiente a matrice
• Una mentalità orientata alle soluzioni

descriptionByLocale.en:
Position Purpose The Associate Director, Statistical Programming provides leadership and expertise in driving the development and maintenance of the CSL statistical programming capabilities which is required to meet regulatory obligations. The individual will work closely with the Director, Statistical Programming to ensure all assigned Statistical Programming tasks are managed to completion. Work closely with Statisticians to ensure that deliverables provided by internal resources or outside providers (CROs; FSP providers) are accurate and aligned with CSL standards. This individual may manage a Therapeutic Areas (TA) or programs within or across TAs working with the Statistics TA lead to ensure all work required in the TA is completed within the project timelines with high quality. Main Responsibilities and Accountabilities
• Working with the Director, Programming to assess upcoming activities and resulting resource needs and ensure high quality, timely, delivery of assigned projects. Ensure realistic project planning.
• Oversee the CRO delivery or manage the in-house programming of data sets, outputs, and DDT files of clinical trials and integrated analysis.
• Plans and leads the design and implementation of complex specifications and programs for applications designed to analyze and report complex clinical trial data in CDISC format.
• Coordinating the oversight or in-house programming of exploratory analyses, analyses to support secondary publications, response to regulatory requests, or other adhoc requests.
• Mentors programmers allocated to assigned projects and provides feedback to managers of these team members as needed.
• As a project or program leader ensures compliance with programming process and strategy to facilitate accurate and timely programming.
• Test and implement state of the art programming methods and tools to the organization and drive automation of delivery, including AI. Education
• BSc in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics or related area with relevant experience
• Other degrees and certifications considered if commensurate with related programming experience Experience
• At least 9 years of experience in either clinical programming and/or statistical programming, within the CRO/pharmaceutical environment using SAS Software.
• Comprehensive understanding of clinical programming and/or statistical programming processes and standards.
• Advanced Experiences with statistical programming using the SAS software including development and use of SAS Macros.
• Advanced knowledge in CDISC standards (CDASH, SDTM, ADaM).
• Proven ability to work effectively both independently or in a team setting, and to meet set goals by managing own timelines.
• Experience in working in cross-functional, multicultural and international clinical trial teams. Competencies
• Coding in SAS, including SAS macro language
• Interest and/or experience in expanding beyond SAS as the primary programming delivery tool
• Experience in and/or passion for automatization of routine programming tasks
• Broad knowledge of clinical development and processes
• Strong interpersonal and communication skills (verbal and written in English), comfortable around senior management
• Ability to collaboratively work in matrix environment
• A solutions oriented mindset
• Fluency in technical requirements for CDISC compatible datasets and DDT files
• Presentations of programming techniques at professional conferences is a plus About CSL Behring CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation
descriptionByLocale.de:
Zweck der Position Der stellvertretende Direktor für statistische Programmierung bietet Führung und Fachwissen bei der Entwicklung und Wartung der CSL-Funktionen für die statistische Programmierung, die zur Erfüllung regulatorischer Verpflichtungen erforderlich sind. Die Person arbeitet eng mit dem Direktor für statistische Programmierung zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass alle zugewiesenen statistischen Programmieraufgaben bis zum Abschluss erledigt werden. Arbeiten Sie eng mit Statistikern zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass die von internen Ressourcen oder externen Anbietern (CROs; FSP-Anbieter) bereitgestellten Ergebnisse korrekt sind und den CSL-Standards entsprechen. Diese Person kann einen therapeutischen Bereich (TA) oder Programme innerhalb oder zwischen TAs leiten und mit dem Statistik-TA-Leiter zusammenarbeiten, um sicherzustellen, dass alle im TA erforderlichen Arbeiten innerhalb der Projektzeitpläne mit hoher Qualität abgeschlossen werden. Hauptaufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten
• Zusammenarbeit mit dem Direktor, Programmierung, um anstehende Aktivitäten und den daraus resultierenden Ressourcenbedarf zu bewerten und eine qualitativ hochwertige, pünktliche Lieferung der zugewiesenen Projekte sicherzustellen. Sorgen Sie für eine realistische Projektplanung.
• Beaufsichtigen Sie die CRO-Bereitstellung oder verwalten Sie die interne Programmierung von Datensätzen, Ausgaben und DDT-Dateien klinischer Studien und integrierter Analysen.

• Betreut Programmierer, die zugewiesenen Projekten zugewiesen sind, und gibt den Managern dieser Teammitglieder bei Bedarf Feedback.

• BSc in Informatik, Mathematik, Statistik oder einem verwandten Bereich mit einschlägiger Erfahrung
• Andere Abschlüsse und Zertifizierungen werden berücksichtigt, wenn sie mit einschlägiger Programmiererfahrung im Einklang stehen. Erfahrung
• Mindestens 9 Jahre Erfahrung in klinischer Programmierung und/oder statistischer Programmierung im CRO/pharmazeutischen Umfeld unter Verwendung von SAS-Software.
• Umfassendes Verständnis der Prozesse und Standards der klinischen Programmierung und/oder der statistischen Programmierung.
• Fortgeschrittene Erfahrungen mit der statistischen Programmierung mithilfe der SAS-Software, einschließlich der Entwicklung und Verwendung von SAS-Makros.
• Fortgeschrittene Kenntnisse in CDISC-Standards (CDASH, SDTM, ADaM).
• Nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, sowohl unabhängig als auch im Team effektiv zu arbeiten und gesetzte Ziele durch die Verwaltung eigener Zeitpläne zu erreichen.
• Erfahrung in der Arbeit in funktionsübergreifenden, multikulturellen und internationalen klinischen Studienteams. Kompetenzen
• Codierung in SAS, einschließlich SAS-Makrosprache
• Interesse und/oder Erfahrung bei der Erweiterung über SAS als primäres Programmierbereitstellungstool hinaus
• Erfahrung und/oder Leidenschaft für die Automatisierung routinemäßiger Programmieraufgaben
• Breites Wissen über klinische Entwicklung und Prozesse
• Starke zwischenmenschliche und kommunikative Fähigkeiten (mündlich und schriftlich in Englisch), vertraut mit der Geschäftsleitung
• Fähigkeit zur Zusammenarbeit in einer Matrixumgebung
• Eine lösungsorientierte Denkweise
• Beherrschung der technischen Anforderungen für CDISC-kompatible Datensätze und DDT-Dateien
• Präsentation von Programmiertechniken auf Fachkonferenzen ist ein Pluspunkt. Über CSL Behring CSL Behring ist ein weltweit führendes Biotherapeutika-Unternehmen, das sich dem Versprechen verschrieben hat, Leben zu retten. Wir konzentrieren uns darauf, den Bedürfnissen der Patienten durch den Einsatz neuester Technologien gerecht zu werden. Wir entdecken, entwickeln und liefern innovative Therapien für Menschen mit Erkrankungen in den Bereichen Immunologie, Hämatologie, Herz-Kreislauf- und Stoffwechselerkrankungen, Atemwegserkrankungen und Transplantationstherapie. Wir nutzen drei strategische wissenschaftliche Plattformen: Plasmafraktionierung, rekombinante Proteintechnologie sowie Zell- und Gentherapie, um kontinuierliche Innovationen zu unterstützen

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'organizzazione R&D di CSL sta accelerando l'innovazione per fornire un maggiore impatto per i pazienti. Con una struttura guidata dal progetto e un focus sulla collaborazione, stiamo costruendo un team pronto per il futuro che prospera negli ecosistemi biotech dinamici. Unirsi a CSL significa ora essere parte di un team agile impegnato a sviluppare terapie che fanno una differenza significativa in tutto il mondo. Potrebbe essere il nostro prossimo direttore, Regional Ecosystem Lead (Northern Europe & UK). Il lavoro è nella nostra Maidenhead UK Office. Questa è una posizione ibrida ed è in loco tre giorni alla settimana. Servire come leader di CSL nei principali hub di innovazione per migliorare il marchio CSL esterno che porta a flusso di accordi BD per crescere il nostro pipeline. Questi leader senior uniranno l'impegno dell'ecosistema, lo scouting strategico e affronteranno la leadership del team per garantire che la CSL mantenga una forte presenza e pipeline di opportunità tra biotech, accademia e reti di investimento. Questo ruolo collabora con R&D globale, sviluppo aziendale e team legali per rafforzare la pipeline di innovazione dell'organizzazione e il vantaggio competitivo. L'individuo leverà profonda conoscenza organizzativa interna, allineare con il GLG, e gli esperti di materia interna (PMI) per posizionare la CSL come partner di scelta negli ecosistemi chiave dell'innovazione biotech. Principali
• Responsabilità e responsabilità · Servire come leader chiave della CSL all'interno dell'ecosistema regionale dell'innovazione, sourcing attivamente opportunità allineate a tutte le strategie TA e priorità del portafoglio. Crea nuove opportunità di partnership per la presenza GLG all'interno di ogni ecosistema. · Mantenere e ampliare le relazioni strategiche con università, incubatori, acceleratori, imprese di capitale di rischio e organizzazioni locali per amplificare le priorità di innovazione esterna della CSL. · Partner a stretto contatto con TA Search conduce a condurre ricerche regionali, impegni di piano e conferenze, e condividere approfondimenti e aggiornamenti regionali. · Servire come membro senior dei team di affari che si verificano in ogni regione, sostenendo le transazioni dall'identificazione attraverso la dovuta diligenza e aiutare a condurre relazioni con i partner esterni attraverso l'affare vicino. · Organizzare e rappresentare la CSL in eventi di innovazione esterna locale, come i giorni di innovazione ospitati dalla CSL, e garantire una forte visibilità nell'ecosistema. · Partecipare attivamente come membro del consiglio di amministrazione in organi e associazioni chiave del settore e perseguire i membri del consiglio o del comitato per influenzare la direzione del settore e rafforzare le reti. · Mantenere la conoscenza intima delle capacità organizzative interne, delle priorità e delle PMI e coinvolgere esperti interni per migliorare la credibilità e la reputazione esternamente. · Fornire informazioni sulle tendenze biotech regionali, paesaggio competitivo e hotspot innovazione. · Lavorare a stretto contatto con R&D, BD e team legali per valutare e integrare le attività esterne. Qualifiche e esperienza
• Requisiti · 10+ anni in biofarmacia, innovazione esterna, o sviluppo aziendale con una forte rete regionale e conoscenza dell'ecosistema. · Grado avanzato richiesto (PhD, MD, o equivalente). · Provato record di traccia di migliorare la presenza di leadership senior Pharma / reputazione come partner di scelta negli ecosistemi biotech per guidare il flusso di affare. · Prova capacità di fonte e valutare le opportunità esterne e condurre l'esecuzione degli accordi. · Forte capacità di costruzione di relazioni con le comunità accademiche, biotech e di investimento. Concentrati sulle esigenze dei pazienti utilizzando le più recenti tecnologie, scopriamo, sviluppiamo e forniamo terapie innovative per le persone che vivono con condizioni di immunologia, ematologia, cardiovascolare e metabolica, respiratoria e trapianto aree terapeutiche. CSL's R&D organization is accelerating innovation to deliver greater impact for patients. With a project-led structure and a focus on collaboration, we’re building a future-ready team that thrives in dynamic biotech ecosystems. Joining CSL now means being part of an agile team committed to developing therapies that make a meaningful difference worldwide. Could you be our next Director, Regional Ecosystem Lead (Northern Europe & UK). The job is in our Maidenhead UK Office. This is a hybrid position and is onsite three days a week. Serve as CSL’s key leader in the key innovation hubs to enhance the CSL external brand leading to BD deal flow to grow our pipeline. These senior leaders will combine ecosystem engagement, strategic scouting, and deal team leadership to ensure CSL maintains a strong presence and pipeline of opportunities across biotech, academia, and investment networks. This role partners with global R&D, business development, and legal teams to strengthen the organization’s innovation pipeline and competitive advantage. The individual will leverage deep internal organizational knowledge, align with the GLG, and internal subject matter experts (SMEs) to position CSL as the partner of choice in the key ecosystems of biotech innovation. ​ Main 
• Responsibilities & Accountabilities​ · Serve as the key CSL leader within the regional innovation ecosystem, actively sourcing opportunities aligned with all TA strategies and portfolio priorities. • Qualifications & Experience

We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives. descriptionByLocale.fr:
L'organisme de R-D de CSL accélère l'innovation pour accroître l'impact sur les patients. Avec une structure dirigée par le projet et un accent sur la collaboration, nous construisons une équipe prête à l'avenir qui prospère dans les écosystèmes biotechnologiques dynamiques. Rejoindre CSL signifie maintenant faire partie d'une équipe agile engagée à développer des thérapies qui font une différence significative dans le monde entier. Pourriez-vous être notre prochain directeur, Responsable des écosystèmes régionaux (Europe du Nord et Royaume-Uni). Le travail est dans notre Maidenhead UK Office. Il s'agit d'une position hybride et se trouve sur place trois jours par semaine. Servir de chef de file clé de la CSL dans les pôles d'innovation clés pour améliorer la marque externe CSL menant au flux de transactions BD pour développer notre pipeline. Ces cadres supérieurs combineront la participation des écosystèmes, le dépistage stratégique et le leadership de l'équipe de négociation afin de s'assurer que l'ESC maintient une forte présence et une gamme de possibilités dans les réseaux de biotechnologie, les universités et les investissements. Ce rôle s'associe à la R-D mondiale, au développement des entreprises et aux équipes juridiques afin de renforcer la capacité d'innovation et l'avantage concurrentiel de l'organisation. L'individu tirera parti de connaissances organisationnelles internes profondes, s'alignera avec le GLG, et des experts en matière interne (PME) pour positionner CSL comme partenaire de choix dans les écosystèmes clés de l'innovation en biotechnologie. Principale
• Responsabilités et responsabilités · Servir de chef de file en matière de LSC au sein de l'écosystème d'innovation régional, en offrant activement des possibilités d'approvisionnement conformes à toutes les stratégies d'AT et aux priorités du portefeuille. Créer de nouvelles possibilités de partenariat pour la présence de GLG dans chaque écosystème. · Maintenir et développer des relations stratégiques avec les universités, les incubateurs, les accélérateurs, les sociétés de capital-risque et les organisations locales afin d'amplifier les priorités d'innovation externe du CSL. · Collaborer étroitement avec les responsables de la recherche de l'AT pour effectuer des recherches régionales, planifier des engagements et des conférences, et partager les idées et les mises à jour régionales. · Servir de membre principal d'équipes de négociation dans chaque région, appuyer les transactions depuis l'identification jusqu'à la diligence raisonnable et aider à diriger les relations avec les partenaires externes jusqu'à la clôture des transactions. · Organiser et représenter le CSL lors d'événements d'innovation externes locaux, comme les journées d'innovation organisées par le CSL, et assurer une forte visibilité dans l'écosystème. · Participer activement en tant que membre du conseil d'administration dans les principaux organismes et associations de l'industrie et poursuivre les membres du conseil ou du comité pour influencer l'orientation de l'industrie et renforcer les réseaux. · Maintenir une connaissance intime des capacités organisationnelles internes, des priorités et des PME et faire appel à des experts internes pour accroître la crédibilité et la réputation à l'extérieur. · Fournir des renseignements sur les tendances de la biotechnologie régionale, le paysage concurrentiel et les points chauds de l'innovation. · Travailler en étroite collaboration avec des équipes de R-D, de BD et de juristes pour évaluer et intégrer les actifs externes. Qualifications et expérience
• Exigences · 10 ans et plus en biopharmacie, en innovation externe ou en développement d'entreprise avec une solide connaissance des réseaux régionaux et des écosystèmes. · Diplôme avancé requis (PhD, MD ou équivalent). · Expérience éprouvée de l'amélioration de la présence et de la réputation des cadres supérieurs de Pharma en tant que partenaire de choix dans les écosystèmes biotechnologiques pour stimuler la circulation des transactions. · Capacité éprouvée d'obtenir et d'évaluer des occasions externes et de diriger l'exécution des marchés. · Des compétences solides en matière de renforcement des relations avec les milieux universitaires, de la biotechnologie et de l'investissement. À propos de CSL Behring CSL Behring est un chef de file mondial en biothérapeutique animé par notre promesse de sauver des vies. Concentré sur les besoins des patients en utilisant les dernières technologies, nous découvrons, développons et livrons des thérapies innovantes pour les personnes vivant dans des conditions dans les domaines immunologiques, hématologiques, cardiovasculaires et métaboliques, respiratoires et transplantés. Nous utilisons trois plateformes scientifiques stratégiques de fractionnement plasmatique, la technologie des protéines recombinantes et la thérapie cellulaire et génique pour soutenir l'innovation continue et affiner continuellement les façons dont les produits peuvent répondre aux besoins médicaux non satisfaits et aider les patients à mener une vie entière. ## Position Purpose
The Senior CI Specialist is responsible for the site-specific advancement of the CSL Operating System (COS) and the implementation of Continuous Improvement initiatives at the Bern site. The role supports Value Stream Packaging/Visual Inspection through data-driven analysis, structured problem-solving methodologies, KPI-based performance management, and the establishment of sustainable process improvements across GMP-relevant workflows.
The role holder acts as SME for CI methodology, promotes an Operational Excellence culture at the site, and ensures that improvement initiatives are implemented in alignment with global CSL standards and local regulatory requirements.

## Reporting Relationships
Reports to: Sigrid Van Dyck - Senior Director, Head of Value Stream Packaging
Interfaces: Value Streams, QA, Planning, Training, Engineering, Supply Chain, Global CI
Functional Integration: Key SME for CI methodology at the Bern site
Direct Reports: None (functional guidance possible)

## Descrizione
Strategic CI Responsibility
- Development, management, and execution of CI roadmaps for all value streams including Operational Service at the Bern site
- Identification of improvement potentials to strengthen compliance, efficiency, and process stability
- Close alignment with the Site Lead Operational Service and Value Stream Leads to strategically embed CI initiatives in the site plan

KPI and Performance Management
- Establishment, further development, and monitoring of relevant performance KPIs (e.g. RFT, Deviation KPIs, BRR KPIs, Training KPIs, OEE-related metrics)
- Execution of trend analyses and derivation of measures for continuous improvement
- Ensuring a standardized dashboard in alignment with global CSL guidelines

Lean & Six Sigma Expertise
- Application and training of recognized tools (5Why, Fishbone, DMAIC, SMED, SIPOC, Kaizen workshops)
- Facilitation of problem-solving workshops and technical support for local deviation and CAPA processes
- Coaching of managers and employees on Lean Thinking, Standardization & Visual Management

Process Optimization & Digitalization
- Analysis of end-to-end processes in close collaboration with Value Streams, Operational Service, M2U, QA, QC and Supply Chain
- Initiation and management of projects for process harmonization, document system optimization, and improvement of digital workflows (e.g. SAP, MES, TrackWise data quality)
- Support of global CI programs and cross-site harmonization topics

Change & Stakeholder Management
- Promotion of a CI culture at the Bern site through targeted communication, workshops, and coaching
- Close collaboration with QA, Manufacturing, Planning, Training & Process Teams to sustainably embed improvements
- Ensuring change readiness in the context of new processes, standards, and tools

## Qualifiche
Education
- Bachelor's degree or higher in a natural science, engineering, or business discipline, or extensive relevant professional experience in a GMP environment
- Lean/Kaizen training, Six Sigma Belt certification

Experience
- Minimum 3–5 years of professional experience in CI, Operational Excellence, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, or Quality
- Solid experience in GMP-regulated production environments (e.g. pharma, biotech)
- Proven experience in CI project management and KPI-driven performance management

Competenze
- Strong proficiency in Lean, Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt desirable)
- Strong analytical skills, confident handling of data analysis tools and KPI systems
- Excellent facilitation, coaching, and communication skills
- Ability to lead cross-functional teams and drive change sustainably
- Business-fluent in German and English

## Requisiti aggiuntivi
- Willingness to conduct workshops in the shopfloor environment (Gemba)
- Ability to present complex matters in a clear and audience-appropriate manner
- High level of initiative, results orientation, and proactive stakeholder management

## Contatto
- Per ulteriori informazioni, contattare Sigrid Van Dyck - Senior Director, Head of Value Stream Packaging.

descriptionByLocale.it:

In questo ruolo, fornirete competenze professionali avanzate e supporto di compensazione consultivo in tutta la regione EMEA, collaborando a stretto contatto con partner aziendali HR, leader aziendali e colleghi globali Total Rewards. Questa posizione supporta la pianificazione, la progettazione e l'esecuzione di programmi di compensazione attraverso diversi e complessi mercati del lavoro. Potrai condurre lavori analitici sofisticati, come la valutazione del lavoro, i prezzi di mercato, la gestione della struttura salariale e la partecipazione alle indagini, assicurando al contempo l'allineamento con le strategie globali di ricompensa, le priorità aziendali regionali e i requisiti normativi locali. Agendo come un connettore chiave tra strategia globale e esecuzione regionale, vi aiuterà a consentire decisioni di ricompensa sonore, competitive e conformi in tutta EMEA. Principali responsabilità
• Servire come esperto in materia di compensazione di fiducia per i partner aziendali HR e i leader aziendali in EMEA, fornendo una guida consultiva su argomenti di ricompensa complessi.
• Sostenere la pianificazione e l'esecuzione dei risarcimenti regionali, compresa la retribuzione base, gli incentivi, le offerte di assunzione, gli scenari di conservazione e le esigenze aziendali ad-hoc, in linea con i quadri globali e le pratiche di mercato locali.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez CSL, nous nous engageons à offrir des thérapies qui changent la vie avec les plus hautes normes de qualité, de sécurité et de fiabilité. Nous sommes à la recherche d'un scientifique principal (m/f/x) Vérification continue du processus (VPC) Comparabilité et statistiques pour jouer un rôle essentiel dans l'assurance d'une qualité de produit uniforme et d'une performance de fabrication robuste tout au long du cycle de vie du produit. Ce rôle se situe à l'intersection des statistiques, de la science de la fabrication et de la conformité réglementaire, en appliquant des analyses de données avancées pour appuyer la prise de décisions, la compréhension des processus et l'amélioration continue dans un environnement pharmaceutique réglementé. Vos responsabilités :
• Appliquer des méthodes statistiques avancées, y compris le CPS, le DOE, la régression et l'analyse multivariée pour appuyer les décisions fondées sur les données
• Collaborer fonctionnellement avec les équipes de la S-T, du développement des procédés, de la fabrication et de la qualité pour appuyer les enquêtes, les écarts et les activités de l'ACAP
• effectuer une analyse statistiquement robuste pour appuyer la mise à jour des limites de surveillance des processus
• effectuer des évaluations de comparabilité statistique pour soutenir les changements de processus et de produits tels que l'échelle, les transferts de sites ou les activités d'optimisation
• Identifier les possibilités d'améliorer la robustesse des processus grâce à des analyses avancées, des outils numériques et des initiatives d'amélioration continue
• Contribuer aux présentations réglementaires et fournir une justification statistique lors des audits et des inspections
• Analyser les données de processus pour identifier les tendances, la variabilité et la dérive potentielle du processus
• soutien aux programmes de vérification continue des procédés (VPC) pour surveiller la performance de fabrication Vos compétences et votre expérience :
• Maîtrise ou doctorat en statistique, génie, biostatistique ou discipline connexe
• Forte expertise en analyse statistique et en interprétation des données
• Une expérience pratique avec des outils statistiques tels que JMP, Minitab, R ou Python
• Bonne connaissance des BPF et des attentes réglementaires
• Expérience à l'appui des études de comparabilité et de la gestion du cycle de vie du produit (préféré)
• La capacité de communiquer clairement des concepts statistiques complexes aux parties prenantes fonctionnelles; À propos de CSL Behring CSL Behring est un chef de file mondial en biothérapeutique animé par notre promesse de sauver des vies. Concentré sur les besoins des patients en utilisant les dernières technologies, nous découvrons, développons et livrons des thérapies innovantes pour les personnes vivant dans des conditions dans les domaines immunologiques, hématologiques, cardiovasculaires et métaboliques, respiratoires et transplantés. Nous utilisons trois plateformes scientifiques stratégiques de fractionnement plasmatique, la technologie des protéines recombinantes et la thérapie cellulaire et génique pour soutenir l'innovation continue et affiner continuellement les façons dont les produits peuvent répondre aux besoins médicaux non satisfaits et aider les patients à mener une vie entière. CSL Behring exploite l'un des plus grands réseaux mondiaux de collecte de plasma, CSL Plasma. Notre société mère, CSL, basée à Melbourne, en Australie, emploie 32 000 personnes et livre ses thérapies vitales à des personnes dans plus de 100 pays. Pour en savoir plus sur CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus et CSL Vifor, visitez https://www.csl.com/ et CSL Plasma à https://www.cslplasma.com/ . Nos avantages Pour plus d'information sur les avantages de la LSC, visitez Comment la LSC soutient votre bien-être. Vous appartenez à CSL Chez CSL, l'inclusion et l'appartenance sont au cœur de notre mission et de ce que nous sommes. Elle alimente notre journée de l'innovation au quotidien. En célébrant nos différences et en créant une culture de curiosité et d'empathie, nous sommes en mesure de mieux comprendre et de communiquer avec nos patients et nos donateurs, de favoriser des relations solides avec nos intervenants et de maintenir une main-d'oeuvre diversifiée qui fera progresser notre entreprise et notre industrie dans l'avenir. Pour en savoir plus sur l'inclusion et l'appartenance, visitez le site https://www.csl.com/careers/inclusion-and-appartenance Employeur CSL est un employeur de l'égalité des chances. Si vous êtes une personne handicapée et avez besoin d'un aménagement raisonnable pour toute partie du processus de demande, veuillez consulter https://www.csl.com/accessibility-stat

Questo ruolo guida la progettazione e l'esecuzione di pratiche integrate di gestione del talento, tra cui l'identificazione e la mobilità ad alto potenziale, la pianificazione di successione, la pianificazione della forza lavoro e la strategia di abilità aziendali. In definitiva, questo ruolo costruisce le competenze e le capacità critiche necessarie per garantire alte prestazioni attraverso CSL. descriptionByLocale.en:
Role Summary The Senior Director, Talent Strategy & Management is a senior enterprise leader responsible for shaping and driving a forward-looking talent strategy that enables scientific innovation, operational excellence, and commercial success in a global biopharma environment. This role leads the design and execution of integrated talent management practices including high-potential identification and mobility, succession planning, workforce planning, and enterprise skills strategy. The role partners closely with the CHRO, VP of Talent, HR Leadership Team, and senior business leaders across the enterprise to ensure strong leadership pipelines, critical capability depth, and future-ready talent aligned to the company’s portfolio and growth strategy. Ultimately, this role builds the critical skills and capabilities needed to ensure high performance across CSL. The Senior Director also develops Board of Directors–level talent insights for Board reports. Key Responsibilities Talent Strategy & Planning
• Develop and evolve an enterprise talent strategy aligned to pipeline priorities, product lifecycle needs, and transformation initiatives
• Translate business and portfolio strategy into actionable talent priorities and investments
• Establish enterprise frameworks and governance for talent management across scientific, technical, and commercial populations
• Integrate talent, culture, and leadership expectations to support innovation and patient impact
• Monitor external talent and industry trends in biopharma and life sciences High-Potential & Top Talent Mobility and Development
• Define and design the enterprise approach for identifying and segmenting high-potential and mission-critical talent
• Lead differentiated development strategies for scientific, technical, and enterprise leadership talent
• Enable cross-functional and cross-geography mobility (e.g., R&D ↔ Commercial ↔ Operations)
• Partner with leadership and learning to build targeted accelerated development experiences into the HiPo Learning programs / pathways Succession Planning & Leadership Pipeline
• Design and govern a robust succession planning process for executive (SD+) and business-critical roles
• Ensure depth and breadth of leadership pipelines for SD+ roles, critical roles and GLG-1 roles and work across key stakeholders to understand & develop internal and external pipeline strategies
• Support HR/Talent Partners to drive rigor, objectivity, and diversity in succession decisions
• Ensure relevant data points are used to provide clear visibility into bench strength, readiness, and risk
• Provide leaders with the Talent Insights they need to build a diverse, future-ready successor pool Workforce Planning
• Lead enterprise workforce planning integrating pipeline scenarios, product launches, and global market needs
• Partner with Finance, Talent Acquisition and business leaders on demand forecasting and scenario planning
• Identify capability gaps and inform build/buy/borrow/bot/bounce strategies
• Implement scalable workforce planning tools and analytics Workforce and Capability Strategy
• Identify future skills and enterprise capabilities required for long-term success
• Partner with workforce planning and L&D to close critical capability gaps
• Integrate skills-based thinking into talent and workforce planning processes
• Partner across HR and business leaders to map and prioritize critical skills
• Enable enterprise skill-building strategies and targeted learning investments
• Support evolution toward skills-based talent practices Stakeholder Leadership
• Serve as a trusted advisor to senior executives and HR leadership
• Collaborate across the E2E Talent Value Chain
• Lead and develop a high-performing talent team
• Own preparation of talent and succession materials for the Board and relevant committees
• Provide data-driven insights on leadership pipeline health, succession readiness, and talent risks
• Ensure

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Résumé du rôle Le directeur principal, Talent Strategy & Management, est un chef de file principal de l'entreprise chargé d'élaborer et de diriger une stratégie axée sur les talents qui favorise l'innovation scientifique, l'excellence opérationnelle et le succès commercial dans un environnement biopharmaceutique mondial. Ce rôle dirige la conception et l'exécution de pratiques intégrées de gestion des talents, y compris l'identification et la mobilité à haut potentiel, la planification de la relève, la planification des effectifs et la stratégie d'entreprise en matière de compétences. Le rôle est étroitement lié au CRHC, au vice-président de Talent, à l'équipe de leadership en RH et aux chefs d'entreprise de l'ensemble de l'entreprise afin d'assurer un leadership solide, une profondeur de capacité critique et des talents prêts à l'avenir alignés sur le portefeuille et la stratégie de croissance de l'entreprise. En fin de compte, ce rôle renforce les compétences et les capacités essentielles nécessaires pour assurer un rendement élevé dans l'ensemble des LSC. Le directeur principal élabore également des rapports sur les talents au niveau du conseil d'administration. Principales responsabilités Stratégie et planification des talents
• Élaborer et mettre au point une stratégie d'entreprise axée sur les talents, en fonction des priorités des pipelines, des besoins du cycle de vie des produits et des initiatives de transformation
• Traduire la stratégie d'affaires et de portefeuille en priorités et investissements concrets en matière de talents
• Établir des cadres d'entreprise et une gouvernance pour la gestion des talents au sein des populations scientifiques, techniques et commerciales;
• Intégrer les attentes en matière de talents, de culture et de leadership pour soutenir l'innovation et l'impact patient
• Surveiller les talents externes et les tendances de l'industrie en biopharmacie et en sciences de la vie Mobilité et développement des talents de haut niveau
• Définir et concevoir l'approche d'entreprise pour identifier et segmenter les talents hautement potentiels et critiques pour la mission
• Diriger des stratégies de développement différenciées pour les scientifiques, les techniciens et les chefs d'entreprise;
• Permettre la mobilité transfonctionnelle et transgéographique (p. ex. R-D, opérations commerciales)
• S'associer au leadership et à l'apprentissage pour créer des expériences de développement accéléré ciblées dans les programmes et les parcours d'apprentissage HiPo Projet de planification de la relève et de leadership
• Concevoir et gouverner un solide processus de planification de la relève pour les cadres (SD+) et les rôles critiques pour les entreprises
• Assurer la profondeur et l'étendue des pipelines de leadership pour les rôles de DD+, les rôles critiques et les rôles GLG-1 et travailler à l'échelle des principaux intervenants pour comprendre et élaborer des stratégies de pipeline internes et externes
• Aider les partenaires RH/Talents à susciter la rigueur, l'objectivité et la diversité dans les décisions de succession
• Veiller à ce que les points de données pertinents soient utilisés pour assurer une visibilité claire de la force, de l'état de préparation et des risques des bancs
• Fournir aux dirigeants les Talent Insights dont ils ont besoin pour constituer un bassin de successeurs diversifié et prêt à l'avenir Planification des effectifs
• La planification de la main-d'œuvre d'entreprise principale intégrant les scénarios de pipeline, les lancements de produits et les besoins du marché mondial
• Partenaire avec Finance, Talent Acquisition et chefs d'entreprise sur la prévision de la demande et la planification des scénarios
• Recenser les lacunes en matière de capacités et éclairer les stratégies de construction/achat/emprunt/bot/bounce
• Mettre en place des outils de planification et d'analyse évolutives des effectifs Stratégie sur les effectifs et les capacités

• S'associer à la planification des effectifs et à la L&D pour combler les lacunes critiques en matière de capacités
• Intégrer la réflexion axée sur les compétences dans les processus de planification des talents et des effectifs
• Établir des partenariats à l'échelle des RH et des chefs d'entreprise pour définir et hiérarchiser les compétences essentielles
• Mettre en place des stratégies de renforcement des compétences et des investissements d'apprentissage ciblés;

Direttore, Operazioni Commerciali e Mediche IT Product Manager Mansioni - Condurre la progettazione e la consegna di piattaforme per la gestione delle entrate, la contrazione, i prezzi, la conformità, le riunioni, la formazione e altri domini operativi. Assicurare l'integrazione senza soluzione di continuità con i sistemi aziendali e la conformità ai requisiti normativi. Attiva l'intelligenza delle decisioni attraverso operazioni commerciali e mediche integrando piattaforme di dati, analisi e workflow che supportano l'esecuzione conforme e scalabile. - Sviluppare e comunicare una visione strategica del prodotto, integrando capacità digitali, dati, automazione e AI per operazioni a prova di futuro. Partner con le parti interessate esecutive per identificare le opportunità di trasformazione e innovazione digitale. - Agire come amministratore di piattaforma, responsabile per l'integrità architettonica a lungo termine, la scalabilità e l'efficienza dei costi, equilibrando le esigenze aziendali a breve termine con gli standard aziendali e l'evoluzione dello stato futuro. - Gestire il ciclo di vita completo del prodotto end-to-end, privilegiando le funzionalità basate sull'impatto aziendale, feedback degli utenti e tendenze tecnologiche emergenti. - Assicurare un'integrazione API robusta, rispettare gli standard di interoperabilità e implementare le pratiche di governance dei dati per fornire soluzioni scalabili, sicure e conformi. - Servire come collegamento primario tra business unit e IT, traducendo i requisiti in soluzioni attuabili, sicure e conformi. descriptionByLocale.en:
The Director, Tech Transfer is a senior leadership role within Technical Operations, responsible for defining and executing the global process and analytical technology transfer strategy across the product lifecycle. In this position, you will play a critical role in ensuring the robust, compliant, and scalable transfer of manufacturing processes and analytical methods across development, internal manufacturing sites, and external partners. You will enable successful commercialization, lifecycle management, and manufacturing network optimization by driving strategic technology transfer initiatives across CSL’s global operations. Working across development, manufacturing, quality, and external partner organizations, you will provide leadership for complex global transfer programs and ensure alignment of transfer execution with portfolio priorities, operational objectives, and regulatory requirements. Responsibilities Strategy & Governance
• Define and continuously evolve the global Tech Transfer strategy covering established process and analytical methods aligned with portfolio, lifecycle, and manufacturing network priorities.
• Establish and govern standardized frameworks, methodologies, and best practices for Tech Transfer.
• Provide strategic input to manufacturing footprint, capacity planning, and long-term operational strategy. Global Tech Transfer Leadership
• Own end-to-end accountability for global Tech Transfer execution including process and analytical methods, ensuring delivery against quality, cost, and timeline targets.
• Oversee transfer strategies, risk assessments, and comparability approaches, ensuring validation readiness and PPQ alignment.
• Ensure complete, effective knowledge transfer and documentation across sending and receiving units.
• Provide senior technical oversight to ensure process robustness, scalability, and consistency across transfers and lifecycle changes.
• Ensure integration of QbD principles and control strategies into transfer execution.
• Lead resolution of complex technical challenges, including scale-up issues, facility fit gaps, and deviations. External Partner & Manufacturing Network Management
• Lead identification, selection, and oversight of CMOs, CROs, and external partners supporting Tech Transfer.
• Conduct technical due diligence and capability assessments for new manufacturing sites and partnerships.
• Ensure external partner performance meets agreed quality, compliance, and delivery standards. Cross-Functional Collaboration
• Ensure seamless collaboration across Process Development, Manufacturing, MS&T, QC, QA, and Engineering.
• Align development, clinical, and commercial organizations on transfer readiness and execution strategy.
• Facilitate structured communication across global stakeholders to ensure alignment and risk mitigation. Performance & Continuous Improvement
• Define and monitor Tech Transfer KPIs (e.g., right-first-time, cycle time, deviation rates).
• Drive structured resolution of transfer risks, deviations, and performance gaps.
• Implement performance oversight and continuous improvement initiatives, including digital and innovative solutions. Qualifications
• Postgraduate degree (PhD preferred) in Life Sciences, Engineering, or related discipline.
• Extensive experience (typically 12+ years) in biopharmaceutical development, manufacturing, or Tech Transfer.
• Proven leadership of complex global Tech Transfer programs across sites and external partners.
• Strong understanding of technology transfer, scale-up, process validation, and regulatory requirements.
• Demonstrated ability to lead large, cross-functional, matrixed organizations.
• Strong track record in external partner management and manufacturing network collaboration.

Mansioni Responsabilità pr - Governance strategica dei partner OT a livello globale - Stabilire e gestire il quadro strategico tecnico mediante il quale i partner esterni servizi operativi e di capitale OT su sistemi di produzione e laboratori GxP, inclusi PCS, MES, OSI PI e piattaforma LIMS. - Fornire governance globale per gli aspetti tecnici dei rapporti con i fornitori, garanzia che gli fisarmonica di servizio master, i piani di qualità, gli fisarmonica di manutenzione, gli fisarmonica di partner KPI e gli impegni del ciclo di vita della piattaforma siano allineati alla strategia OT dell'impresa e applicazione in modo coerente in tutti i siti. - Modello operativo condiviso per i partner OT - Definire e gestire il modello condiviso per i partner OT, inclusi la gestione dei servizi dell'impresa e i template di progetto T1 a livello globale utilizzato su tutte le piattaforme. - Coordinare responsabili con i proprietari dei contratti funzionali in modo che le prestazioni del partner, l'ambito e le consegne sostengano l'esecuzione attendibile, conformi e economicamente vantaggiosa di entrambi i lavori di supporto operativo e i progetti di capitale in tutto l'ecosistema OT. Compiti Governance globale OT e modello di servizi condivisi - Stabilire e mantenere il quadro di governance globale per i partner OT, inclusi i fornitori di piattaforme strategiche, i fornitori strategici e i modelli di consegna dei servizi condivisi. - Definire i ruoli, le responsabilità e le autorizzazioni tra i partner di primo livello, i servizi condivisi e i interni team per evitare sovrapposizioni e suggerimenti. - Garantire che le pratiche di governance del partner (revisioni, escalation, approvazioni) siano applicate in modo coerente in tutte le regioni e i siti. - Favorire l'adesione in collaborazione con DQ e CSV alle aspettative GxP, di sicurezza e normativa in tutti i servizi e progetti consegnati dai partner. Struttura dei servizi condivisi e dei servizi dell'impresa - Progettare e supervisionare la struttura dei servizi condivisi per i servizi consegnati dai partner OT (esecuzione, manutenzione, miglioramento) su PCS, MES, OSI PI, LIMS e piattaforme correlate. - Definire il catalogo dei servizi OT a livello globale, gli SLA/KPI e il RACI per i team interni, i servizi condivisi e i partner esterni. - Coordinare con gli stakeholder globali e dei siti per garantire che i servizi siano dimensionati, sostenibili ed economicamente vantaggiosi. - Monitorare i dati delle prestazioni dei servizi e guidare nella affidabilità, nella risposta e nella qualità dei servizi condivisi e consegnati dai partner. Contratti, MSA e template dei progetti - Possedere e mantenere gli fisarmonica di servizio master, i piani di qualità, gli strumenti di servizio e gli strumenti di manutenzione per i partner OT strategici e i servizi condivisi a livello globale. - Piattaforma, standardizzare e migliorare ulteriormente i template dei contratti dei progetti per l'utilizzo su tutte le piattaforme e i tipi di progetti OT. - Collaborare con At-site E&M, Legale, Acquisti e i proprietari dei contratti funzionali per garantire che i contratti definiscano chiaramente l'ambito, le consegne, la conformità e le strutture dei prezzi. - Periodicamente rivede e aggiorni i termini dei contratti per riflettere le esigenze aziendali in evoluzione, la postura sul rischio e le prestazioni del partner. Gestione della consegna dei progetti del partner - Supervisionare la qualità della consegna dei progetti del partner per i progetti operativi e di capitale OT, garanzia l'adesione agli standard globali, ai template e alla governance. - Stabilire le aspettative per la governance del progetto del partner, la documentazione, i test e il passaggio alle operazioni per tutti i progetti guidati dal partner. - Raccogliere e integrare le lezioni apprese relative al partner nei processi di governance del partner, negli standard e nei template a livello globale. Ciclo di vita della piattaforma e allineamento dell'impresa - Garantire che gli fisarmonica del partner e dei servizi condivisiino il ciclo di vita completo delle piattaforme OT (introduzione, espansione, aggiornamenti, decommissioning). - Allineare le responsabilità del partner con i roadmap delle piattaforme per PCS, MES, OSI PI, LIMS e altre applicazioni OT. - Coordinare con l'architettura OT, I&T e i proprietari delle piattaforme per confermare che le attività del ciclo di vita siano definite, risorse e programmate contrattualmente. - Monitorare l'esecuzione delle attività del ciclo di vita e guidare le azioni correttive.
• Requisiti Esperienza - Esperienza dimostrata nella gestione dei partner e dei fornitori a livello globale in un ambiente di GxP produzione. - Esperienza nella gestione dei contratti e dei progetti a livello globale. - Esperienza nella definizione e nell'implementazione di modelli di servizi condivisi e di governance. Competenze - Capacità di gestire relazioni con i partner e i fornitori a livello globale. - Capacità di definire e implementare strategie di governance dei partner e dei servizi condivisi. - Capacità di gestire progetti e contratti a livello globale. - Capacità di comunicare in modo efficace con gli stakeholder a livello globale. - Conoscenza dei processi di produzione GxP e delle normative applicabili. - Conoscenza dei sistemi OT, inclusi PCS, MES, OSI PI e LIMS. descriptionByLocale.en:
The Opportunity:
• The Global OT Partner Enablement Lead is accountable for establishing and governing the strategic technical framework by which external partners deliver operational and capital OT services across GxP manufacturing and laboratory systems, including PCS, MES, OSI PI, and LIMS platforms.
• This role provides global governance for the technical aspects of supplier relationships, ensuring that master service agreements, quality plans, service agreements, maintenance agreements, partner KPIs, and platform lifecycle commitments are aligned to the enterprise OT strategy and consistently applied across all sites.
• Additionally, this role is responsible for defining and managing the shared services operating model for OT partners, including enterprise services management and the global T1 project contracting templates used across all platforms, and for coordinating closely with functional contract owners so that partner performance, scope, and deliverables support reliable, compliant, and cost-effective execution of both operational support and capital project work throughout the OT ecosystem. The Role:
• Global OT Partner Governance & Shared Service Model -
• Establish and maintain the global governance framework for OT partners, including strategic platform providers, strategic suppliers and shared service delivery models.
• Define roles, responsibilities, and interfaces between Tier 1 partners, shared services, and internal teams to avoid overlap and gaps.
• Ensure partner governance practices (reviews, escalations, approvals) are consistently applied across all regions and sites.
• Drive adherence in collaboration with DQ and CSV to GxP, safety, and regulatory expectations in all partner-delivered services and projects.
• Enterprise Services & Shared Services Structure-
• Design and oversee the shared services structure for OT partner-delivered services (run, maintain, enhance) across PCS, MES, OSI PI, LIMS, and related platforms.
• Define the global OT service catalog, SLAs/KPIs, and RACI for internal teams, shared services, and external partners.
• Coordinate with global and site stakeholders to ensure services are right-sized, sustainable, and cost-effective.
• Monitor service performance data and drive improvements in reliability, responsiveness, and quality of shared and partner-delivered services.
• Contracting, MSAs & Project Templates-
• Own and maintain global master service agreements, quality plans, service agreements, and maintenance agreements for strategic OT partners and shared services.
• Develop, standardize, and continuously improve project contracting templates for use across all OT platforms and project types.
• Partner with At-site E&M, Legal, Procurement, and functional contract owners to ensure contracts clearly define scope, deliverables, compliance, and pricing structures.
• Periodically review and refresh contract terms to reflect evolving business needs, risk posture, and partner performance.
• Partner Project Delivery Management-
• Oversee partner project delivery quality for OT-related operational and capital projects, ensuring adherence to global standards, templates, and governance.
• Establish expectations for partner project governance, documentation, testing, and handover to operations for all partner-led projects.
• Capture and feed partner related project lessons learned into global standards, templates, and partner governance processes.
• Platform Lifecycle & Enterprise Alignment-
• Ensure partner and shared service agreements support the full lifecycle of OT platforms (introduction, expansion, upgrades, decommissioning).
• Align partner responsibilities with platform roadmaps for PCS, MES, OSI PI, LIMS, and other OT enterprise applications.
• Coordinate with OT Architecture, I&T, and platform owners to confirm lifecycle activities are contractually defined, resourced, and scheduled.
• Track execution of lifecycle activities and drive corrective act

Titolo: Scienziato senior –Bioassays Funzione: Sviluppo del metodo, Tech Ops Rapporti a: Direttore associato, Sviluppo dei metodi Scopo del ruolo: Lo scienziato senior responsabile per la progettazione, lo sviluppo, la qualificazione e la gestione del ciclo di vita di test vincolanti, enzimatici e basati sulle cellule che supportano la biologia e le terapie avanzate attraverso la scoperta, lo sviluppo e le fasi commerciali. Questo ruolo fornisce una profonda esperienza tecnica per i bioassay complessi, assicurando che i metodi siano adatti per gli usi, adeguati alla fase e robusti, mentre mentoring gli scienziati e influenzano la strategia CMC cross-funzionale. Responsabilità chiave: Leadership scientifica e tecnica:
• Guidare lo sviluppo e l'ottimizzazione di saggi di legame (ad esempio, ELISA, SPR/BLI), saggi enzimatici e bioassay basati sulle cellule per potenza, MoA e caratterizzazione.
• Definire la strategia di analisi allineata alla fase MoA, CQAs e clinica, inclusa la selezione di materiali di riferimento, controlli e criteri di accettazione.
• Risolvere complesse sfide di test, tra cui variabilità, effetti di matrice, specificità, deriva e rilevanza biologica.
• Guidare la robustezza, la comprensione meccanicistica e la rilevanza biologica, in particolare per la potenza e le analisi funzionali. Metodo di convalida e gestione del ciclo di vita:
• Autore e approva i profili di destinazione analitici (ATP), i rapporti di sviluppo dei metodi e le relazioni di pre-qualificazione in linea con le aspettative di ICH Q2(R2), ICH Q14, USP e EP.

• Partner with automation, data, and IT teams to modernize bioassay workflows. Required Qualifications & Experience:
• PhD in Biochemistry, Molecular Biology, Biotechnology, Immunology, or related discipline (or equivalent experience).

• Demonstrated expertise in potency assay development and MoA‑linked bioassays.

To do this, the GMP Site Quality Associate has the primary purpose of ensuring compliance with GMP/GSP/GxP by providing front‑line quality guidance and support across all phases of Technical Product Development. You will also ensure self‑inspections are conducted and followed up in a timely manner and provide quality and compliance support throughout all aspects of technical product. • Participate in IPT Project and associate delivery team meetings, providing quality/compliance leadership, guidance and advice

• Provide training in QMS principles as required
• Participate in updating of QA documents as relevant to Technical Development

• Educate technical staff in GxP and quality system requirements
• Establish and maintain local and global product‑related Quality Agreements
• Position Qualifications and Experience Requirements Education A degree in a relevant biological science, with at least 3 years’ experience in at least one of the following areas:
• Manufacturing under GMP
• Regulatory Affairs
• Quality Assurance

• In‑depth understanding of GMP requirements in the pharmaceutical industry and previous Production, Quality or R&D experience within the pharmaceutical industry
• Sound knowledge of processes for Clinical Trial GMP manufacture
• Understanding of the product development process and environment is desirable

• Ability to relate to and communicate with people of different technical skill backgrounds and at different levels from management to operations within CSL
• Good analytical and problem‑solving skills

Oggetto Scienziato senior con un alto livello di esperienza nella biofisica proteica per caratterizzare una varietà di proteine terapeutiche. L'incumbent applica un forte background tecnico in biomolecole caratterizzazione a entusiasmanti progetti interdisciplinari che lavorano in un ambiente di team collaborativo sulle strumentazioni all'avanguardia. Collabora con altri scienziati e partner esterni per sviluppare saggi analitici idonei all'uso, suggerire flussi di lavoro e fornire supporto tecnico e formazione per consentire processi critici decisionali e sostenere continue attività di sviluppo della droga. In questa posizione, un elevato livello di conoscenza delle tecniche biofisiche è essenziale per fornire analisi analitiche appropriate di fase e per supportare una maggiore caratterizzazione del prodotto. Lo scienziato senior contribuirà a tradurre piattaforme innovative e nuove tecnologie in metodi completamente sviluppati e possibilmente automatizzati. L'entusiasmo scientifico, la creatività, l'esperienza di laboratorio e l'impegno saranno essenziali per il successo del team e degli obiettivi e dei tempi organizzativi. Principali responsabilità e responsabilità
• Responsabile per la progettazione e l'esecuzione di esperimenti e per l'interpretazione dei risultati delle tecniche basate sulla biofisica e sulla cromatografia per supportare la caratterizzazione di nuovi prodotti derivati dal plasma e prodotti commercializzati.

He/she will partner with other scientists and external partners to develop fit-for-purpose analytical assays, suggest workflows and provide technical support and training to enable critical process decision-making and support continuous drug development activities. In this position, a high level of knowledge of biophysical techniques is essential to deliver phase appropriate analytical assays and to support enhanced product characterization. The Senior Scientist will contribute to translate innovative platforms and new technologies into fully developed, possibly automated methods. Scientific enthusiasm, creativity, hands-on lab experience and commitment will be essential for the successful achievement of team and organizational goals and timelines. • providing clinical oversight and expertise during development of clinical studies
• serves as medical monitor for assigned clinical trials or provides oversight to an assigned medical monitor

• the clinical sections of relevant regulatory packages (e.g. IND, NDA, annual reports) and support regulatory RFIs as needed.
• the development of abstracts, presentations, and manuscripts as appropriate. Main Responsibilities: 1 Clinical Development Team (CDT) Leadership:
• Leads the integration of internal and external expert contributions to strategy and design of the assigned clinical program(s).
• Responsible for maintaining alignment across critical stakeholders prior to key decision making forums (e.g. Strategic and Technical Review Committee (STRC) for study outline approval.
• Ensures that the program is conducted in alignment with CSL Behring processes and abiding by GCP and ICH regulations.
• Responsible for driving and documenting decision making within the CDT, facilitating issue resolution and escalation, as well as contingency planning. 2 Clinical & Scientific Oversight:
• Accountable for the clinical content for all CDT deliverables to ensure safe, efficient, and timely execution of assigned clinical programs.
• Ensures high quality clinical and scientific standards are met throughout all aspects of the program.
• Serves as the clinical development representative on the required cross-functional Delivery Teams (DT) including but not limited to the Safety Management Team (SMT), the Benefit-Risk Assessment Team (BRAT), the Biomarker Expert Team (BET), and the Evidence and Access Strategy Team (EAST) for assigned programs.
• Develops and executes the Medical Monitoring Plan (MMP) strategy. Typically serves as the medical monitor for clinical trials during study conduct or provides oversight to assigned medical monitors.
• Presents results to Safety Monitoring Committee and other internal and external meetings. 3 Document Authorship:
• Reviews the data generated during the planning and execution of a study to gather a clinical understanding of the safety and efficacy results and the impact of the data on ongoing R&D strategies and provides support in defining the development strategy.
• Leads preparations of clinical sections of relevant regulatory interaction packages including but not limited to briefing books, INDs, NDAs. BLAs, ODDs, RFIs, and routine reporting.
• Contributing author the publication strategy. Author or contributing author for abstracts, presentations, and manuscripts as appropriate. Qualifications and Experience Requirements:

Descrizione Vous serez responsable de la conception et de l'exécution de la stratégie clinique pour appuyer l'élaboration d'un médicament, conformément au Document de stratégie du projet (DSP) et au Profil du produit cible (PPT). Vous êtes également responsable du leadership stratégique de l'équipe de développement clinique (ECC) dans un environnement matriciel et vous êtes responsable : - l'élaboration et l'exécution opportunes du Plan de développement clinique (PDC). - gérer les activités quotidiennes du CDT, y compris, sans s'y limiter, la coordination et la documentation des réunions, la prise de décisions et la gestion des intervenants. - s'assurer que le programme est mené en conformité avec les processus de consanguinité de la LSC et qu'il est conforme aux règlements du GCP et de l'ICH. Ce poste est responsable de la surveillance clinique et scientifique du ou des programmes assignés et : - s'assure que les normes cliniques et scientifiques de haute qualité sont respectées pendant tous les aspects du programme - fournir une surveillance clinique et une expertise pendant le développement des études cliniques - sert de moniteur médical pour les essais cliniques assignés ou assure la surveillance d'un moniteur médical assigné - est le représentant du développement clinique des équipes de prestation interfonctionnelles (DT) Cette position est un Auteur Lead ou Auteur Contribuant pour: - les principaux documents d'étude, y compris, sans s'y limiter, le Plan de développement clinique (PDC), le Document de stratégie du projet (DSP), les Brochures des chercheurs (IB), les Protocoles d'étude clinique (PSC), les Formulaires de consentement éclairé (FIC), les Plans de surveillance médicale (PMM), les Rapports d'étude clinique (REC). - les sections cliniques des trousses réglementaires pertinentes (p. ex. IND, NDA, rapports annuels) et appuyer les DDR réglementaires au besoin. - l'élaboration de résumés, de présentations et de manuscrits selon les besoins. Mansioni 1 Leadership de l'équipe de développement clinique (ECC) : - Dirige l'intégration des contributions internes et externes d'experts à la stratégie et à la conception des programmes cliniques assignés. - Responsable du maintien de l'alignement entre les intervenants essentiels avant les forums de prise de décisions clés (p. ex. Comité d'examen stratégique et technique (CRST) pour approbation du plan d'étude. - S'assure que le programme est mené en conformité avec les processus CSL Behring et qu'il est conforme aux règlements GCP et ICH. - Responsable de la conduite et de la documentation de la prise de décisions au sein du CDT, facilitant la résolution des problèmes et l'escalade, ainsi que la planification d'urgence. 2 Surveillance clinique et scientifique : - Rendre compte du contenu clinique de tous les produits livrables des CDT afin d'assurer l'exécution sécuritaire, efficace et en temps opportun des programmes cliniques assignés. - S'assurer que les normes cliniques et scientifiques de haute qualité sont respectées dans tous les aspects du programme. - Assure le rôle de représentant du développement clinique dans les équipes de prestation interfonctionnelles requises, y compris, sans s'y limiter, l'équipe de gestion de la sécurité (EMS), l'équipe d'évaluation des risques et des avantages (EAR), l'équipe d'experts en biomarqueurs (EAR) et l'équipe de stratégie sur les preuves et l'accès (EAR) pour les programmes assignés. - Élaborer et exécuter la stratégie du Plan de surveillance médicale. Habituellement, il sert de moniteur médical pour les essais cliniques au cours de l'étude ou assure la surveillance des moniteurs médicaux affectés. - Présente les résultats au Comité de surveillance de la sécurité et à d'autres réunions internes et externes. 3 Auteur du document : - Examiner les données générées au cours de la planification et de l'exécution d'une étude afin de recueillir une compréhension clinique des résultats en matière d'innocuité et d'efficacité ainsi que de l'incidence des données sur les stratégies de R-D en cours et aider à définir la stratégie de développement. - Dirige la préparation des sections cliniques des trousses d'interaction réglementaire pertinentes, y compris, sans s'y limiter, les cahiers d'information, les IND et les ADN. BLA, ODD, DDR et rapports de routine. - Contribuer à la stratégie de publication. Auteur ou auteur contributeur pour les résumés, les présentations et les manuscrits selon le cas.
• Requisiti - MD - Certifice du Conseil
