descriptionByLocale.it:
Oggetto L'Enterprise Implementation Lead – Horizon 2 è un ruolo di leadership senior Technical Operations responsabile per l'implementazione e la validazione tecnica a livello aziendale del programma Horizon 2. Il programma Horizon 2 includeva una tecnologia brevettata, che migliora la resa di produzione che consente una produzione di immunoglobulina significativamente superiore dalla stessa quantità di base del plasma. Operando all'interno dell'organizzazione del programma Horizon 2, il ruolo serve come integratore primario di impresa in Tech Ops, Manufacturing, Quality, Engineering & Maintenance (E&M), e consentendo progetti di capitale, garantendo l'intento tecnico, la maturità di processo, i risultati di validazione, gli apprendisti di programma e i contenuti tecnici conformi alle normative sono tradotti coerentemente in esecuzione efficace e sostenibile in scala. Responsabilità del ruolo Horizon 2 Programma Capacità tecniche L'Enterprise Implementation Lead è responsabile per la consegna tecnica end-to-end del programma Horizon 2 attraverso lo sviluppo, l'implementazione del processo, il trasferimento tecnologico, la validazione e la creazione di sviluppo e contenuti tecnici necessari per supportare i processi normativi globali. Ciò include la traduzione di output di sviluppo in soluzioni di produzione scalabili e conformi e garantire che le conoscenze di processo, le strategie di controllo, le prove di validazione e le narrazioni tecniche conformi alle normative siano saldamente stabilite per consentire presentazioni di successo e la distribuzione in corso, nonché la nuova espansione attraverso la rete CSL.
• Guidare e integrare le attività di sviluppo tecnico attraverso l'implementazione del processo, garantendo continuità dell'intento tecnico e della prontezza per la produzione
• Definire ed eseguire strategie di implementazione di processi aziendali che convertono gli apprendimento di sviluppo in soluzioni pronte al sito, eseguibili in strutture nuove e esistenti
• Possedere e coordinare le responsabilità Tech Ops per il trasferimento di tecnologia, compresa la definizione di strategie di trasferimento, parametri di processo critici e criteri di successo in tutti i siti
• Tenere la responsabilità della strategia di validazione e dell'esecuzione associata al programma Horizon 2, assicurando che la validazione sia basata sul rischio, pronta all'ispezione e allineata alle aspettative normative
• Possedere allo sviluppo e all'integrazione dei contenuti tecnici e di sviluppo necessari per le presentazioni normative, assicurando la coerenza tra i dati di sviluppo, le prove di validazione e le narrazioni di archiviazione
• Assicurare l'allineamento tra i dati di sviluppo, i risultati delle qualifiche, le prove di validazione e i contenuti normativi per supportare la prontezza operativa e la produzione GMP sostenibile
• Drive Right-First-Time (RFT) consegna attraverso la gestione del rischio tecnico disciplinato, risoluzione dei problemi e processo decisionale basato sui dati Collaborazione, integrazione e governance
• Partner con Manufacturing on Operational Readiness fornendo ingressi Tech Ops tra cui conoscenze di processo, requisiti di trasferimento tecnico, stato di validazione e trasparenza del rischio di processo
• Partner con Engineering & Maintenance (E&M) nella fornitura di progetti per garantire che i requisiti di processo, i parametri e i criteri di accettazione di Tech Ops siano chiaramente definiti e allineati con le aspettative di progettazione, costruzione, qualificazione e erogazione di asset
• Collaborare a stretto contatto con gli Affari di Qualità e Regolazione per sviluppare, rivedere e approvare strategie di validazione, contenuti di presentazione normativi e narrazioni di prontezza di ispezione, garantendo l'allineamento tra esecuzione tecnica e impegni normativi
• Mantenere il registro di rischio tecnico, convalida e regolamentare a livello aziendale per il programma Horizon 2, con percorsi di chiara proprietà e di escalation
• Servire come principale canale di comunicazione tecnica tra siti, leadership di programma, forum di qualità, regolamentazione e governance Leadership del team
• Lead a magra, senior Tech Ops focalizzato implementazione e validazione team (diretto e matrice)
• Acro di apprendimento, riutilizzo e miglioramento continuo
descriptionByLocale.en:
Position Purpose The Enterprise Implementation Lead – Horizon 2 is a senior Technical Operations leadership role accountable for the enterprise-wide technical implementation and validation of the Horizon 2 program. The Horizon 2 program included a patented, yield enhancing manufacturing technology that enables significantly higher immunoglobulin production from the same base amount of plasma. Operating within the Horizon 2 program organization, the role serves as the primary enterprise integrator across Tech Ops, Manufacturing, Quality, Engineering & Maintenance (E&M), and enabling capital projects, ensuring technical intent, process maturity, validation outcomes, program learnings, and regulatory-facing technical content are coherently translated into effective and sustainable execution at scale. Role Responsibilities Horizon 2 Program Technical Accountabilities The Enterprise Implementation Lead is accountable for the end-to-end technical delivery of the Horizon 2 program across development, process implementation, technology transfer, validation, and the creation of development and technical content required to support global regulatory filings. This includes translating development outputs into scalable, compliant manufacturing solutions and ensuring that process knowledge, control strategies, validation evidence, and regulatory-facing technical narratives are robustly established to enable successful submissions and ongoing deployment as well as new expansion across the CSL network.
• Lead and integrate technical development activities through to process implementation, ensuring continuity of technical intent and readiness for manufacturing scale-up
• Define and execute enterprise process implementation strategies that convert development learnings into site-ready, executable solutions across new and existing facilities
• Own and coordinate Tech Ops accountabilities for technology transfer, including definition of transfer strategies, critical process parameters, and success criteria across sites
• Hold accountability for validation strategy and execution associated with the Horizon 2 program, ensuring validation is risk-based, inspection-ready, and aligned with regulatory expectations
• Own the development and integration of technical and development content required for regulatory submissions, ensuring consistency between development data, validation evidence, and filing narratives
• Ensure alignment between development data, qualification outcomes, validation evidence, and regulatory content to support Manufacturing operational readiness and sustainable GMP production
• Drive Right-First-Time (RFT) delivery through disciplined technical risk management, issue resolution, and data-driven decision-making Cross-Functional Collaboration, Integration & Governance
• Partner with Manufacturing on Operational Readiness by providing Tech Ops inputs including process knowledge, tech transfer requirements, validation status, and process risk transparency
• Partner with Engineering & Maintenance (E&M) in project delivery to ensure Tech Ops process requirements, parameters, and acceptance criteria are clearly defined and aligned with design, construction, qualification, and asset handover expectations
• Partner closely with Quality and Regulatory Affairs to jointly develop, review, and approve validation strategies, regulatory submission content, and inspection readiness narratives, ensuring alignment between technical execution and regulatory commitments
• Maintain the enterprise-level technical, validation, and regulatory risk register for the Horizon 2 program, with clear ownership and escalation paths
• Serve as the primary technical communication conduit between sites, program leadership, Quality, Regulatory, and governance forums Team Leadership
• Lead a lean, senior Tech Ops-focused implementation and validation team (direct and matrixed)
• Drive enterprise learning, reuse, and continuous improvement acros
descriptionByLocale.de:
Aufgabenstellung Die Enterprise Implementation Lead – Horizon 2 ist eine leitende Führungsrolle für die unternehmensweite technische Umsetzung und Validierung des Horizon 2 Programms. Das Horizon 2 Programm beinhaltete eine patentierte, leistungssteigernde Fertigungstechnologie, die eine deutlich höhere Immunglobulinproduktion aus der gleichen Basismenge Plasma ermöglicht. Im Rahmen der Horizon 2 Programmorganisation fungiert die Rolle als primärer Unternehmensintegrator über Tech Ops, Manufacturing, Quality, Engineering & Maintenance (E&M) und ermöglicht Kapitalprojekte, die sicherstellen, dass technische Absichten, Prozessreife, Validierungsergebnisse, Programmerwerbe und regulatorisch ausgerichtete technische Inhalte kohärent in effektive und nachhaltige Ausführung im Maßstab übersetzt werden. Aufgaben Horizon 2 Programm Technische Rechenschaften Die Enterprise Implementation Lead ist verantwortlich für die technische End-to-End-Lieferung des Horizon 2 Programms über Entwicklung, Prozessumsetzung, Technologietransfer, Validierung und die Erstellung von Entwicklungs- und technischen Inhalten, die zur Unterstützung globaler regulatorischer Einreichungen erforderlich sind. Dazu gehören die Übersetzung von Entwicklungsausgängen in skalierbare, konforme Fertigungslösungen und die Sicherstellung, dass Prozesswissen, Steuerungsstrategien, Validierungsnachweise und regulatorisch ausgerichtete technische Erzählungen robust etabliert sind, um erfolgreiche Einreichungen und laufende Bereitstellung sowie neue Erweiterungen im gesamten CSL-Netzwerk zu ermöglichen.
• Führen und integrieren Sie technische Entwicklungsaktivitäten durch die Prozessdurchführung, Sicherstellung der Kontinuität der technischen Absicht und der Bereitschaft zur Herstellung von Scale-up
• Festlegung und Durchführung von Strategien zur Umsetzung von Strategien zur Umsetzung von Entwicklungslern in standortbereite, ausführbare Lösungen in neuen und bestehenden Einrichtungen
• Eigene und koordinierende Rechenschaftspflichten für den Technologietransfer, einschließlich Definition von Transferstrategien, kritischen Prozessparametern und Erfolgskriterien an Standorten
• Halten Sie die Rechenschaftspflicht für Validierungsstrategie und Durchführung im Zusammenhang mit dem Horizon 2 Programm, um sicherzustellen, dass die Validierung risikobasiert, inspiziert und mit regulatorischen Erwartungen ausgerichtet ist
• Eigene Entwicklung und Integration von technischen und entwicklungsbezogenen Inhalten, die für regulatorische Einreichungen erforderlich sind, um die Konsistenz zwischen Entwicklungsdaten, Validierungsnachweisen und Anmelden zu gewährleisten
• Sicherstellung der Angleichung zwischen Entwicklungsdaten, Qualifikationsergebnissen, Validierungsnachweisen und regulatorischen Inhalten zur Unterstützung der betrieblichen Bereitschaft der Fertigung und der nachhaltigen GMP-Produktion
• Führen Sie die Lieferung von Recht-Erst-Zeit (RFT) durch diszipliniertes technisches Risikomanagement, Problemlösung und datengesteuerte Entscheidungsfindung Cross-Functional Collaboration, Integration & Governance
• Partner bei der Herstellung von Betriebsbereitschaft durch die Bereitstellung von Tech Ops-Inputs, einschließlich Prozesswissen, Technologietransferanforderungen, Validierungsstatus und Prozessrisikotransparenz
• Partner mit Engineering & Maintenance (E&M) in der Projektauslieferung, um sicherzustellen, dass die Prozessanforderungen, Parameter und Akzeptanzkriterien von Tech Ops klar definiert und mit den Erwartungen von Design, Konstruktion, Qualifizierung und Vermögensübernahme abgestimmt werden
• Partner eng mit Quality and Regulatory Affairs zusammenarbeiten, um gemeinsam Validierungsstrategien, regulatorische Einreichungsinhalte und Inspektionsbereitschafts-Erzählungen zu entwickeln, zu überprüfen und zu genehmigen, um eine Angleichung zwischen technischer Ausführung und regulatorischen Verpflichtungen sicherzustellen
• Pflege des technischen, Validierungs- und regulatorischen Risikoregisters für das Horizon 2 Programm mit klaren Eigentums- und Eskalationswegen
• Als primäre technische Kommunikationsleitung zwischen Standorten, Programmleitung, Qualität, Regulierung und Governance-Foren dienen Teamleiter
• Führen Sie ein schlankes, Senior Tech Ops-fokussiertes Implementierungs- und Validierungsteam (direkt und matrixförmig)
• Unternehmen lernen, wiederverwenden und kontinuierliche Verbesserung Akros
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Fonction Le responsable de la mise en oeuvre de l'entreprise – Horizon 2 est un chef de file principal des opérations techniques responsable de la mise en oeuvre et de la validation techniques à l'échelle de l'entreprise du programme Horizon 2. Le programme Horizon 2 comprenait une technologie de fabrication brevetée qui améliore le rendement et permet une production d'immunoglobuline significativement plus élevée à partir de la même quantité de plasma de base. Fonctionnant au sein de l'organisation du programme Horizon 2, ce rôle est l'intégrateur principal de l'entreprise dans les opérations techniques, la fabrication, la qualité, l'ingénierie et la maintenance (E&M), et permet des projets d'immobilisations, assurant l'intention technique, la maturité du processus, les résultats de validation, les apprentissages du programme et le contenu technique axé sur la réglementation sont traduits de façon cohérente en une exécution efficace et durable à l'échelle. Rôle Responsabilités Responsabilités techniques du programme Horizon 2 Le responsable de la mise en oeuvre de l'entreprise est responsable de la prestation technique de bout en bout du programme Horizon 2 au cours de l'élaboration, de la mise en oeuvre des processus, du transfert de technologie, de la validation et de la création du développement et du contenu technique requis pour appuyer les dépôts réglementaires mondiaux. Il s'agit notamment de traduire les extrants de développement en solutions de fabrication évolutives et conformes et de s'assurer que les connaissances sur les processus, les stratégies de contrôle, les preuves de validation et les descriptions techniques axées sur la réglementation sont solidement établies pour permettre la réussite des soumissions et le déploiement continu ainsi que l'expansion du réseau de LSC.
• Diriger et intégrer les activités de développement technique par le biais de la mise en œuvre des processus, en assurant la continuité de l'intention technique et la préparation à l'expansion de la fabrication
• Définir et exécuter des stratégies de mise en œuvre des processus d'entreprise qui convertissent les apprentissages de développement en solutions exécutables prêtes à être mises en place dans les installations nouvelles et existantes
• Posséder et coordonner des responsabilités en matière de transfert de technologie, y compris la définition de stratégies de transfert, de paramètres de processus critiques et de critères de succès pour tous les sites
• Tenir compte de la stratégie de validation et de l'exécution du programme Horizon 2, en veillant à ce que la validation soit axée sur les risques, prête à l'inspection et conforme aux attentes réglementaires
• S'approprier l'élaboration et l'intégration du contenu technique et du contenu de développement requis pour les présentations réglementaires, en assurant la cohérence entre les données de développement, les preuves de validation et les textes explicatifs de classement
• Assurer l'alignement entre les données de développement, les résultats de qualification, les preuves de validation et le contenu réglementaire pour soutenir la préparation opérationnelle de la fabrication et la production durable de BPF
• Diriger la prestation du droit pour la première fois grâce à une gestion des risques techniques disciplinée, à la résolution des problèmes et à la prise de décisions axées sur les données Collaboration interfonctionnelle, intégration et gouvernance
• Partenaire avec Manufacturing on Operational Ready en fournissant des intrants Tech Ops comprenant des connaissances sur les processus, les exigences de transfert de technologie, l'état de validation et la transparence des risques liés aux processus
• S'associer à l'ingénierie et à la maintenance (E&M) pour assurer que les exigences, les paramètres et les critères d'acceptation des opérations techniques soient clairement définis et alignés sur les attentes en matière de conception, de construction, de qualification et de transfert d'actifs
• Collaborer étroitement avec Qualité et Affaires réglementaires pour élaborer, examiner et approuver conjointement les stratégies de validation, le contenu des présentations réglementaires et les textes explicatifs sur la préparation à l'inspection, en assurant l'alignement entre l'exécution technique et les engagements réglementaires
• Tenir à jour le registre des risques techniques, de validation et réglementaires au niveau de l'entreprise pour le programme Horizon 2, avec des voies claires de propriété et d'escalade
• Servir de canal de communication technique principal entre les sites, le leadership du programme, la qualité, la réglementation et les forums de gouvernance Leadership d'équipe
• Diriger une équipe de mise en œuvre et de validation axée sur les opérations techniques (directe et matricielle)
• Favoriser l'apprentissage, la réutilisation et l'amélioration continue des entreprises

descriptionByLocale.en:
The Ecosystem Lead defines ecosystem-specific COS standards for Operations, Supply Chain, QA/QC, Maintenance, and Technical Operations in partnership with OE, site, and functional stakeholders. It oversees the installation and continuous improvement of the CSL Operating System across sites and supported functions through Gemba walks, site visits, and maturity assessments. The role supports ecosystem value delivery by working with teams from T4 to T1 and enables the deployment of structured problem-solving, Lean, and Six Sigma tools as appropriate. Responsibilities: Define ecosystem-specific standards:
• Define content specific to each function
• Identify and support resolution of interdependencies
• Stakeholder management and leadership across full ecosystem
• Update standards / playbook in alignment with OE and Core Teams Support maturity build:
• Partnering with site & functional leadership
• Support maturity build & value, identify required efforts (w/ OE)
• Planning/execution of future deployments
• Calibration of maturity assessment through site visits Support value delivery:
• Monitor value capture & drive accountability
• Strategy planning, prioritization & budgeting
• Contribute to key initiatives Implement and coach leadership ecosystem within function
• Implement tiered meeting cascade and CBN/CI review within function
• Contribute and coach effectiveness of T4 team Lead key cross site initiatives
• Lead key cross-site initiatives raised through T4 CBN/CI review
• Places a high priority on developing others through coaching, feedback.
• Foster a culture of continuous improvement, training and mentoring while focusing on operational efficiency and the elimination of “non-value added” activities.
• Provide a positive and equitable working environment emphasizing the CSL Values: Customer Focus, Innovation, Integrity, Collaboration, and Superior Performance.
• Complies with requirements from CSL Behring’s Safety Program, including Health and Safety mandates and OSHA requirements.
• Completes any other duties/responsibilities assigned by senior management. Qualifications:
• Bachelor or BS degree in a Technical or Business Field with 10+ years’ experience, master’s degree in business administration or technical discipline a plus
• Lean and Six Sigma proficiency preferred, certifications in Lean and Six Sigma a plus
• Worked within operational or functional roles in key leadership roles such as Value stream lead, Deployment Lead, etc.
• Previous experience in Lean production system implementation
• Experience of aligning global processes across multiple sites
• Experience in coaching senior leaders
• Experience in implementation of lean operating model including 5S, Kaizen, waste reduction, in process excellence and performance improvement tools.
• Experience deploying goals at high level
• Strategic Thinking – Align ecosystem standards with business goals.
• Stakeholder Leadership – Influence and collaborate across functions and sites.
• Continuous Improvement – Drive Lean practices and operational excellence.
• Change Leadership – Lead transformation and sustain improvements.

Mansioni Il Direttore di Imballaggio Secondario è un ruolo di leadership all'interno del dipartimento di Sistemi e Imballaggio di Farmaci (DDSP) di CSL. In questo ruolo, avrai l'opportunità di influenzare come i farmaci vengono consegnati ai pazienti di CSL, avanzare gli obiettivi di sostenibilità a livello globale e guidare la trasformazione della categoria sviluppando strategie a lungo termine. Ciò include la supervisione della transizione dai materiali e processi a soluzioni innovative, centrate sul paziente e sostenibili dal punto di vista ambientale. In questo ruolo, interessarai e guiderai le strategie globali della categoria per l'intero portfolio di prodotti di CSL, collaborando con la produzione, la catena di fornitura, le operazioni tecniche (compresi gli interventi di primaria importanza, dispositivo e fattori umani all'interno del DDSP), la qualità, il commerciale, la regolamentazione e la procura. Agirai come leader del pensiero nella tecnologia, nella sostenibilità e nell'innovazione dei fornitori, guidando la strategia di integrazione di CSL verso soluzioni future. Responsabilità - Evolvere i processi di sviluppo dell'ordine secondario - promuoverai nuovi processi, l'adozione di nuovi strumenti, decisioni basate sui dati e tecnologie avanzate lungo la catena del valore dell'annuncio. Ciò comprenderà anche l'integrazione nei processi di sviluppo dei prodotti combinati. - Piattaforma pianificazioni e capacità di secondario per garantire che i prodotti CSL rispettino i requisiti di mercato, conformi norma, qualità e produzione. Valutare i fallimenti dell'ordine secondario per determinarne le cause radicali e le azioni correttive. - Realizzare un impatto significativo sulla sostenibilità - plasmerai le iniziative che garantiranno il rispetto degli impegni ambientali a livello globale. - Contribuire a una rete di fornitori globali ad alte prestazioni - collaborare con la catena di fornitura e la procura per: partnership con i fornitori per guidare i percorsi di innovazione e garantire la resilienza e la qualità della base di fornitura globale dell'ordine. - Conoscenze professionali per coach e mentor dei collaboratori diretti e per fornire sviluppo della carriera ai membri del team. - Responsabile della creazione di piani di forza lavoro, piani di successione e piani di personale per garantire che il talento disponibile sia massimizzato per raggiungere i risultati aziendali per CSL.
• Requisiti - Laurea in Ingegneria dell'Imballaggio o in un campo correlato. - Almeno 10 anni di esperienza nel campo dell'ordine secondario nel settore dei dispositivi medici e/o farmaceutico. - Esperienza nella serializzazione e in altre misure anticontraffazione. - Esperienza con ISTA e ASTM per l'annuncio e la spedizione simulata. - Proven track record nello sviluppo di strategie e nella guida di progetti di miglioramento. - Eccellenti capacità comunicative e un'esperienza dimostrata nel lavoro in un ambiente a matrice; Influenzare/creare/promuovere una cultura di miglioramento continuo. - Forte leadership attraverso un approccio di partnership e coinvolgimento con la produzione per avanzare i risultati di qualità e l'eccellenza operativa. CSL Comportamento CSL Behring è un leader globale nelle bioterapie, guidato dalla nostra promessa di salvare vite. Concentrandoci sulle esigenze dei pazienti attraverso l'utilizzo delle tecnologie più avanzate, scopriamo, sviluppiamo e consegniamo terapie innovative per le persone che vivono con certezza nell'area terapeutica dell'immunologia, dell'ematologia, della cardiologia e del metabolismo, della respirazione e del trapianto. Utilizziamo tre piattaforme scientifiche strategiche di frazionamento del plasma, tecnologia proteica ricombinante e terapia cellulare e genica per supportare l'innovazione continua e rafinare continuo i modi in cui i prodotti possono affrontare le esigenze mediche non soddisfatte e aiutare i pazienti a vittime vite piene. CSL Ecco l'opera una delle più grandi reti di raccolta di plasma del mondo, CSL Plasma. La nostra casa madre, CSL, con sede a Melbourne, in Australia, impiega 32.000 persone e fornisce le sue terapie salvavita alle persone in più di 100 paesi. Job Description: The Director of Secondary Packaging is a leadership role within CSL’s Drug Delivery Systems & Packaging (DDSP) department. In this position, you will have the opportunity to shape how medicines are delivered to CSL’s patients, advance global sustainability objectives, and drive category transformation by developing long-term strategies. This includes overseeing the transition from conventional materials and processes to innovative, patient-focused, and environmentally sustainable solutions. In this role, you will influence and drive complex global category strategies across CSL’s product portfolio working with manufacturing, supply chain, technical operations (including primary packaging, device, and human factors areas within DDSP), quality, commercial, regulatory, and procurement. You will act as a thought leader in technology, sustainability, and supplier innovation, steering CSL packaging strategy toward future‑ready solutions. Responsibilities
• Evolve secondary packaging development processes – you will champion new processes, the adoption of new tools, data driven decision making, and advanced technologies across the packaging value chain. This will also include integration into combination product development processes.
• Develop secondary packaging designs and capabilities to ensure that CSL products meet market, regulatory compliance, quality, and manufacturing requirements. Assess secondary packaging failures to determine root causes and corrective actions.
• Deliver meaningful sustainability impact – you will shape initiatives that will ensure we meet global environmental commitments.
• Contribute to a high-performing global supplier network – partner with supply chain and procurement on: supplier partnerships to drive innovation pipelines and ensure resilience and quality of our global packaging supply base.
• Professional knowledge to coach and mentor direct reports and to provide career development for team members.
• Responsible for creating workforce plans, succession plans, and staffing plans for to ensure available talent is maximized to achieve business results for CSL. Qualifications
• Packaging or other Engineering degree.
• At least 10 years of related experience in secondary packaging within the medical device and or pharmaceutical industry.
• Expertise in serialization and other anticounterfeit measures
• Experience with ISTA and ASTM for packaging and simulated shipping.
• Proven ability to develop strategies and lead improvement projects.
• Excellent communication skills and a track record working in a matrix environment; Influencing/building/promoting a culture of continuous improvement.
• Strong leadership through a partnership and engagement approach with manufacturing for advancing quality outcomes and operational excellence. About CSL Behring CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives. CSL Behring operates one of the world’s largest plasma collection networks, CSL Plasma. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries. To learn more about CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus and CSL Vifor visit https://www.csl.com/ and CSL Plasma at https://www.cslplasma.com/ . Our Benefits For more information on CSL benefits visit How CSL Supports Your Well-being | CSL . You Belong at CSL At CSL, I

Mansioni Il Direttore di Imballaggio Secondario è un ruolo di leadership all'interno del dipartimento di Sistemi e Imballaggio di Farmaci (DDSP) di CSL. In questo ruolo, avrai l'opportunità di influenzare come i farmaci vengono consegnati ai pazienti di CSL, avanzare gli obiettivi di sostenibilità a livello globale e guidare la trasformazione della categoria sviluppando strategie a lungo termine. Ciò include la supervisione della transizione dai materiali e processi convenzionali a soluzioni innovative, centrate sul paziente e sostenibili dal punto di vista ambientale. In questo ruolo, influenzerai e guiderai le strategie globali della categoria per l'intero portfolio di prodotti di CSL, collaborando con la produzione, la catena di fornitura, le operazioni tecniche (compresi gli ambiti di imballaggio primario, dispositivo e fattori umani all'interno del DDSP), la qualità, il commerciale, la regolamentazione e la procura. Agirai come leader del pensiero nella tecnologia, nella sostenibilità e nell'innovazione dei fornitori, guidando la strategia di imballaggio di CSL verso soluzioni future. Responsabilità - Evolvere i processi di sviluppo dell'imballaggio secondario - promuoverai nuovi processi, l'adozione di nuovi strumenti, decisioni basate sui dati e tecnologie avanzate lungo la catena del valore dell'imballaggio. Ciò comprenderà anche l'integrazione nei processi di sviluppo dei prodotti combinati. - Sviluppare progettazioni e capacità di imballaggio secondario per garantire che i prodotti CSL rispettino i requisiti di mercato, conformità normativa, qualità e produzione. Valutare i fallimenti dell'imballaggio secondario per determinarne le cause radicali e le azioni correttive. - Realizzare un impatto significativo sulla sostenibilità - plasmerai le iniziative che garantiranno il rispetto degli impegni ambientali a livello globale. - Contribuire a una rete di fornitori globali ad alte prestazioni - collaborare con la catena di fornitura e la procura per: partnership con i fornitori per guidare i percorsi di innovazione e garantire la resilienza e la qualità della base di fornitura globale dell'imballaggio. - Conoscenze professionali per coach e mentor dei collaboratori diretti e per fornire sviluppo della carriera ai membri del team. - Responsabile della creazione di piani di forza lavoro, piani di successione e piani di personale per garantire che il talento disponibile sia massimizzato per raggiungere i risultati aziendali per CSL.
• Requisiti - Laurea in Ingegneria dell'Imballaggio o in un campo correlato. - Almeno 10 anni di esperienza nel campo dell'imballaggio secondario nel settore dei dispositivi medici e/o farmaceutico. - Esperienza nella serializzazione e in altre misure anticontraffazione. - Esperienza con ISTA e ASTM per l'imballaggio e la spedizione simulata. - Bewährte Erfolgsbilanz nello sviluppo di strategie e nella guida di progetti di miglioramento. - Eccellenti capacità comunicative e un'esperienza dimostrata nel lavorare in un ambiente a matrice; Influenzare/creare/promuovere eine cultura di miglioramento continuo. - Forte leadership attraverso un approccio di partnership e coinvolgimento con la produzione per avanzare i risultati di qualità e l'eccellenza operativa. CSL Behring CSL Behring è un leader globale nelle bioterapie, guidato dalla nostra promessa di salvare vite. Concentrandoci sulle esigenze dei pazienti attraverso l'utilizzo delle tecnologie più avanzate, scopriamo, sviluppiamo e consegniamo terapie innovative per le persone che vivono con patologie nell'area terapeutica dell'immunologia, dell'ematologia, della cardiologia e del metabolismo, della respirazione e del trapianto. Utilizziamo tre piattaforme scientifiche strategiche di frazionamento del plasma, tecnologia proteica ricombinante e terapia cellulare e genica per supportare l'innovazione continua e raffinare costantemente i modi in cui i prodotti possono affrontare le esigenze mediche non soddisfatte e aiutare i pazienti a condurre vite piene. CSL Behring opera una delle più grandi reti di raccolta di plasma del mondo, CSL Plasma. La nostra casa madre, CSL, con sede a Melbourne, in Australien, impiega 32.000 persone e fornisce le sue terapie salvavita all persone in più di 100 paesi. supervisionare la gestione delle deviazioni, l'indagine sulle deviazioni e l'istituzione di azioni correttive e preventive, oltre a sviluppare, monitorare e segnalare gli indicatori chiave di performance (KPI) per l'ingegneria e la manutenzione - For our CSL Behring Operations / Manufacturing, we are looking for a Head of Manufacturing Engineering and Maintenance Closing Date for Applications – 17th April 2026 The Head of Manufacturing Engineering & Maintenance is a strategic leader responsible for the reliability and lifecycle management of manufacturing assets. This role oversees Calibration & Metrology Engineering, Manufacturing Maintenance, Reliability Engineering, Production/System Owner Engineering, and Shutdown Planning & Scheduling. Key responsibilities support critical operations, including fractionation, bulk production, and packaging, while ensuring equipment readiness and compliance with regulatory standards in the biopharmaceutical sector. The position also requires strong skills in labour relations to foster collaboration within a unionized workforce. Role that this position reports to: Engineering & Maintenance Site Head Job Purpose
• Direct all aspects of manufacturing engineering and maintenance, including technical support, project management, emergency response, on-call, troubleshooting and corrective, preventive/predictive maintenance
• Ensure facilities and equipment are designed, operated and maintained in compliance with cGMP, Health Authorities (i.e. FDA), EHS
• Drives execution of qualification plans, risk analysis, metrology, data integrity and general GMP issues
• Lead the planning, budgeting, execution and commissioning of major capital projects, facility expansions, and technology upgrades
• Champion asset lifecycle management, reliability engineering and implementation
• Oversees sites workshop operations
• Develop, communicate and execute an engineering and maintenance strategy
• Lead transformation initiatives, including digitalization, advanced automation, sustainability and adoption of cutting-edge manufacturing technologies
• Supports the development and implementation of multi-year strategic plans, capital investment roadmaps and operational readiness programs for all global site
• Lead the sites manufacturing engineering and maintenance organization
• Oversee deviation management, investigation of deviations and establishment of corrective and preventive actions plus develop, monitor and report on Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for engineering and maintenance
• Represent the local manufacturing engineering and maintenance function in regulatory inspections, audit readiness
• Champion the use of digital tools and data analytics (e.g., SAP, Trackwise, FMS, Ariba, Power BI, Smart Sheet, Tableau) and implement CSL Operating System, Six Sigma, Lean
• Conducts regular GEMBAS
• Oversee the management of GMP/non-GMP facility systems
• Manage relationships with external service providers, contractors and vendors
• Partner with Manufacturing, Quality, EHS, Supply Chain, IT and other departments
• Engage with global and regional leadership
• Lead, mentor and develop a diverse, cross-functional team
• Oversees assigned cost centres, monitors performances and acts on trends
• Develops budgets for OpEx and headcounts Your Skills and Experience
• Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Chemical, Mechanical, Electrical) required, a master’s preferred
• Minimum of ten years’ experience in the pharmaceutical, food, or chemical process industry
• At least five years of technical management or leadership experience
• Significant expertise in GMP/non-GMP manufacturing assets related to pharmaceutical production
• Expertise in sterile manufacturing, bulk production and finishing and packaging operations of (bio) pharmaceuticals
• Experience managing union and non-union workforces
• Advanced skills in facility management systems (Trackwise, SAP, FMS, Ariba, DCMS) and digital tools (MS Project, Excel, Power BI, Smart Sheet, Tableau)
• Knowledge of Six Sigma/Lean principles
• Financial acumen in managing multimillion-dollar budgets
• Experience with global health authorities’ inspections, audits and regulatory agencies We lo

descriptionByLocale.en:
The Principal Statistical Programmer is responsible for providing leadership and hands-on support in the development and maintenance of the CSL statistical programming capabilities which is required to meet regulatory obligations. The individual will work closely with the Associate Director, Director, and Statistical Programmers to build internal programming tools. This individual, working closely with the study team, will be responsible for review and acceptance of contract research organization (CRO) deliverables which are mainly, but not limited to, datasets in submission ready standard format (ADaM), tables, figures, listings and submission packages. This individual will provide expertise in the design, development and quality control process for SAS programs used to access, extract, transform, review, analyze and submit clinical data for all requested analyses. This individual will collaborate with other departments (eg, Biostatistics, Data Management, Regulatory Operations, Medical Writing, ESP teams) to ensure Standard Operating Procedures are followed and the correct study data are used for all requests. This individual will participate in department and cross functional technology development and process improvement initiatives. Main Responsibilities and Accountabilities:
• Collaborates with the study teams to design data structure and specifications for ad hoc and study deliverables including, but not limited to ADaM datasets, Tables, Figures, Listings and Analysis Submission content. Plans and leads the production and validation efforts for the designed output, this may include oversight of work by CROs.
• Collaborates with study teams to ensure the quality and accuracy – thus submission readiness – of clinical data as required by authorities (i.e. SDTM, ADaM, tables, figures, listings, define.xml). Supports the review of related deliverables when provided by CROs.
• Leads and oversees requested efforts for pooled and exploratory analyses working closely with Statistics TA lead and/or study statisticians as well as with clinical programming team and their collection of legacy data.
• Leads and oversees the in-house specification and delivery of ISS and ISE datasets and associated output (tables, figures and listings) when not provided by CRO.
• Leads and oversees the design and implementation of complex SAS programs for applications designed to analyze and report complex clinical trial data in CDISC ADaM format.
• Leads and oversees the development of global tools that will increase the efficiency and capacity of the Statistical Programming group.
• Works closely with clinical study teams to execute activities to ensure project timelines are met with high quality deliverables. Additional tasks: Collaborates with CR&D staff regarding data analysis requests. Performs additional statistical analyses including but not limited to:
• support responses to regulatory agencies,
• generate integrated summary of safety and efficacy,
• support publications and presentations,
• support planning and reporting of clinical trials via exploratory analyses of available data,
• replicate CRO and CSL statistician analyses for QC Job Qualifications and Experience Requirements: Education
• BSc in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics or related area with relevant experience
• Other degrees and certifications considered if commensurate with related programming experience Experience
• At least 7 years of experience in either clinical programming and/or statistical programming, within the CRO/pharmaceutical environment using SAS Software.
• In-depth understanding of clinical programming and/or statistical programming processes and standards.
• In-depth understanding of regulatory requirements relevant to statistical programming (e.g. GCP, ICH).
• Extensive experience with statistical programming using the SAS software including development and use of SAS Macros. Strong programming and problem-solving skills.
• Advanced kn

Job Description: The engineering Associate Director of Sustaining Engineering is a new role within CSL’s Drug Delivery Systems & Packaging (DDSP). This role will provide technical leadership to support marketed combination products. The individual will work with DDSP and peer departments, e.g., Quality Assurance, to implement changes and improvements to combination products to ensure safety and reliability. Changes may include process optimization, CDMO evaluation, tech transfers, supplier-related changes, and risk management updates. This role will also identify and leverage best practices supporting the needs of a diverse combination product portfolio as well as formalizing and standardizing approaches. This role serves as a key interface between DDSP, project teams, External Organizations, Commercial, and corporate initiatives for scoping and vetting design improvement projects. Responsibilities:
• The role ensures all sustaining activities are conducted in compliance with applicable standards and regulations including ISO 13485, ISO 14971, 21 CFR Part 4, QMSR, and 211, and relevant ICH guidelines.
• Partner with manufacturing, CDMOs, and quality to drive design improvements, process optimizations, and supplier changes through the appropriate change control and regulatory pathways.
• The Associate Director represents the function in cross-functional program teams, design reviews, and regulatory interactions, providing expert input on device reliability to Health Authority submissions (e.g., NDA/BLA device sections).
• The Associate Director supports regulatory audits and inspections and maintains a deep understanding of the evolving combination product regulatory landscape.
• Monitor and provide input into product complaint process to identify opportunities for improvement.
• Provide key insights and lessons learned to educate new product development leads on best practices.
• Utilize technical project management skills, including resource planning, work planning, risk management, prioritization, conflict management, change management, issue resolution, and progress reporting.
• Responsible for identifying and implementing requirements for safety, quality, and reliability are effectively met for CSL commercialized combination products. Basic Qualifications
• Bachelor’s in engineering (mechanical or chemical preferred)
• Minimum 10 years of experience in either parenteral or device manufacturing in the pharmaceutical space
• Leadership experience in team management or supervision
• Experience with manufacturing processes, validation practices, and cGMP guidelines
• Knowledge of process automation and equipment reliability
• Ability to collaborate with internal teams, CMs, and contractors About CSL Behring CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives. CSL Behring operates one of the world’s largest plasma collection networks, CSL Plasma. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries. To learn more about CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus and CSL Vifor visit https://www.csl.com/ and CSL Plasma at https://www.cslplasma.com/ . Descrizione
• Stiamo cercando un Regional Regulatory Lead (RRL) strategico e collaborativo da inserire nel nostro team Global Regulatory Affairs. In questo ruolo, guiderai attività normative sia strategiche che operative all'interno di un'area terapeutica (TA) assegnata nelle regioni APAC, LATAM e delle aziende partner. Lavorerai a stretto contatto con le parti interessate globali e regionali per garantire approvazioni normative tempestive e una gestione efficace del ciclo di vita per i prodotti designati. Collaborando con il responsabile dell'area terapeutica e con il responsabile della regolamentazione globale, contribuirai alle strategie normative globali adattando ed eseguendo strategie regionali in linea con le priorità aziendali e commerciali. Questa è un’entusiasmante opportunità per svolgere un ruolo chiave nel portare terapie critiche ai pazienti nei mercati internazionali dinamici e in rapida crescita. Responsabilità chiave: agire come responsabile della regolamentazione regionale per i prodotti e i paesi assegnati, garantendo l'allineamento con la strategia e le priorità normative globali. - Sviluppare e implementare strategie normative regionali che supportino le registrazioni dei prodotti, la gestione del ciclo di vita e gli obiettivi aziendali. - Identificare percorsi efficienti di approvazione normativa in collaborazione con i rappresentanti locali delle autorità di regolamentazione (LRR) e i rappresentanti dei partner normativi (RPR). - Contribuire alle attività del Global Regulatory Affairs Strategy Team (GRAST) e supportare lo sviluppo di strategie normative globali. - Guidare e supervisionare le attività normative in tutto il portafoglio assegnato, identificando e gestendo in modo proattivo i rischi normativi. - Garantire comunicazioni normative e risposte di alta qualità alle domande dell'Autorità sanitaria in linea con i requisiti e le tempistiche regionali. - Collaborare strettamente con le parti interessate interne, gli LRR e gli RPR per supportare approvazioni tempestive e conformità normativa. - Costruire e mantenere forti rapporti con le autorità sanitarie regionali attraverso una comunicazione efficace e una documentazione di alta qualità. - Rimani informato sulla legislazione normativa internazionale, sulle linee guida e sugli sviluppi del settore rilevanti per i prodotti e le attività CSL. - Valutare l'impatto dell'evoluzione delle normative locali e regionali e fornire valutazioni del rischio normativo. - Supportare iniziative di miglioramento continuo per migliorare i processi normativi, la conformità e l'eccellenza operativa. Qualifiche ed esperienza Istruzione: laurea in scienze biologiche, scienze mediche, farmacia o un campo correlato. - Le qualifiche post-laurea o la specializzazione in Drug Regulatory Affairs sono considerate un vantaggio. Esperienza - Minimo 5 anni di esperienza in materia normativa nei mercati internazionali. - È altamente auspicabile ulteriore esperienza nel settore farmaceutico o biotecnologico. Capacità e competenze: è richiesto un inglese fluente. - Ulteriori lingue sono considerate una risorsa (ad esempio arabo, francese, spagnolo, russo). - Ottima conoscenza dello sviluppo di prodotti farmaceutici e dei requisiti normativi. - Conoscenza dei principi GMP e GCP. - Eccellenti capacità di comunicazione, gestione degli stakeholder e organizzative. - Capacità di lavorare efficacemente in un ambiente globale e interfunzionale. Perché unirsi a noi? Si tratta di un'opportunità unica per contribuire alla fornitura di terapie che cambiano la vita ai pazienti di tutto il mondo, lavorando in un ambiente globale collaborativo e innovativo. Noi di CSL siamo impegnati nel miglioramento continuo, nell’eccellenza scientifica e nel fare una differenza significativa nella vita dei pazienti. Informazioni su CSL Behring CSL Behring è un leader globale nel campo della bioterapia guidato dalla nostra promessa di salvare vite umane. In this role, you will lead both strategic and operational regulatory activities within an assigned Therapeutic Area (TA) across APAC, LATAM, and Partner Business Regions. You will work closely with global and regional stakeholders to ensure timely regulatory approvals and successful lifecycle management for designated products. Partnering with the Therapeutic Area Lead and the Global Regulatory Lead, you will contribute to global regulatory strategies while adapting and executing regional strategies aligned with business and commercial priorities. This is an exciting opportunity to play a key role in bringing critical therapies to patients across dynamic and fast-growing international markets. Key Responsibilities
• Act as the regional regulatory lead for assigned products and countries, ensuring alignment with global regulatory strategy and priorities.
• Develop and implement regional regulatory strategies that support product registrations, lifecycle management, and business objectives.
• Identify efficient regulatory approval pathways in collaboration with Local Regulatory Representatives (LRRs) and Regulatory Partner Representatives (RPRs).
• Contribute to Global Regulatory Affairs Strategy Team (GRAST) activities and support the development of global regulatory strategies.
• Lead and oversee regulatory activities across the assigned portfolio, proactively identifying and managing regulatory risks.
• Ensure high-quality regulatory submissions and responses to Health Authority questions in line with regional requirements and timelines.
• Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders, LRRs, and RPRs to support timely approvals and regulatory compliance.
• Build and maintain strong relationships with regional Health Authorities through effective communication and high-quality documentation.
• Stay informed on international regulatory legislation, guidelines, and industry developments relevant to CSL products and activities.
• Assess the impact of evolving local and regional regulations and provide regulatory risk assessments.
• Support continuous improvement initiatives to enhance regulatory processes, compliance, and operational excellence. Qualifications & Experience Education
• Degree in Biological Sciences, Medical Sciences, Pharmacy, or a related field.
• Postgraduate qualifications or specialization in Drug Regulatory Affairs are considered an advantage. Experience
• Minimum 5 years of regulatory affairs experience within international markets.
• Additional pharmaceutical or biotech industry experience is highly desirable. Skills & Competencies
• Fluent English is required.
• Additional languages are considered an asset (e.g., Arabic, French, Spanish, Russian).
• Strong understanding of pharmaceutical product development and regulatory requirements.
• Knowledge of GMP and GCP principles.

• Anforderungen und Fristen. - Mit internen Stakeholdern, LRRs und RPRs eng zusammenarbeiten, um rechtzeitige Genehmigungen und regulatorische Compliance zu unterstützen. - Errichten und pflegen Sie starke Beziehungen zu regionalen Gesundheitsbehörden durch effektive Kommunikation und hochwertige Dokumentation. - Bleiben Sie informiert über internationale Regulierungsvorschriften, Richtlinien und Branchenentwicklungen, die für CSL-Produkte und -Aktivitäten relevant sind. - Berücksichtigen Sie die Auswirkungen der sich entwickelnden lokalen und regionalen Verordnungen und liefern regulatorische Risikobewertungen. - Unterstützung kontinuierlicher Verbesserungsinitiativen zur Verbesserung regulatorischer Prozesse, Compliance und operativer Exzellenz.
• Qualifications & Experience Education - Diplom in Biologie, Medizinwissenschaften, Pharmazie oder einem verwandten Bereich. - Postgraduierte Qualifikationen oder Spezialisierung auf Drogenregulierungsangelegenheiten gelten als Vorteil. Erfahrung - Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in regulatorischen Angelegenheiten auf internationalen Märkten. - Zusätzliche Erfahrung in der pharmazeutischen oder biotechnologischen Industrie ist sehr wünschenswert. Fähigkeiten & Kompetenzen - fließendes Englisch ist erforderlich. - Zusätzliche Sprachen gelten als Aktiva (z.B. Arabisch, Französisch, Spanisch, Russisch). - Starkes Verständnis der pharmazeutischen Produktentwicklung und regulatorischen
• Anforderungen. - Kenntnisse der GMP- und GCP-Prinzipien. - Ausgezeichnete Kommunikation, Stakeholder-Management und organisatorische Fähigkeiten. - Fähigkeit, effektiv in einer globalen und funktionsübergreifenden Umgebung zu arbeiten. Warum bei uns? Dies ist eine einzigartige Gelegenheit, zur Bereitstellung von lebensverändernden Therapien für Patienten weltweit bei der Arbeit in einem kollaborativen und innovativen globalen Umfeld beizutragen. Bei der CSL setzen wir uns für eine kontinuierliche Verbesserung, wissenschaftliche Exzellenz und machen einen sinnvollen Unterschied im Leben der Patienten. Über CSL Behring CSL Behring ist ein weltweit führender Biotherapeutiker, der von unserem Versprechen, Leben zu retten, angetrieben wird. Im Fokus auf die Bedürfnisse der Patienten mit den neuesten Technologien, entdecken, entwickeln und liefern wir innovative Therapien für Menschen mit Bedingungen in der Immunologie, Hämatologie, Herz-Kreislauf- und Stoffwechsel-, Atem- und Transplantationstherapie. Wir nutzen drei strategische wissenschaftliche Plattformen der Plasmafraktionierung, rekombinante Proteintechnologie und Zell- und Gentherapie, um weitere Innovatio zu unterstützen

Description Nous recherchons un responsable de la réglementation régionale (RRL) stratégique et collaboratif pour rejoindre notre équipe des affaires réglementaires mondiales. Dans ce rôle, vous dirigerez les activités réglementaires stratégiques et opérationnelles au sein d'un domaine thérapeutique (TA) attribué dans les régions APAC, LATAM et partenaires. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les parties prenantes mondiales et régionales pour garantir les approbations réglementaires en temps opportun et une gestion réussie du cycle de vie des produits désignés. En partenariat avec le responsable du domaine thérapeutique et le responsable de la réglementation mondiale, vous contribuerez aux stratégies réglementaires mondiales tout en adaptant et en exécutant des stratégies régionales alignées sur les priorités commerciales. Il s’agit d’une opportunité passionnante de jouer un rôle clé en apportant des thérapies essentielles aux patients sur des marchés internationaux dynamiques et en croissance rapide. Principales responsabilités - Agir en tant que responsable régional de la réglementation pour les produits et les pays assignés, en assurant l'alignement avec la stratégie et les priorités réglementaires mondiales. - Développer et mettre en œuvre des stratégies réglementaires régionales qui soutiennent les enregistrements de produits, la gestion du cycle de vie et les objectifs commerciaux. - Identifier les voies d'approbation réglementaires efficaces en collaboration avec les représentants réglementaires locaux (LRR) et les représentants des partenaires réglementaires (RPR). - Contribuer aux activités de l'équipe de stratégie des affaires réglementaires mondiales (GRAST) et soutenir le développement de stratégies réglementaires mondiales. - Diriger et superviser les activités réglementaires dans l'ensemble du portefeuille assigné, en identifiant et en gérant de manière proactive les risques réglementaires. - Assurer des soumissions réglementaires de haute qualité et des réponses aux questions des autorités sanitaires conformément aux exigences et aux délais régionaux. - Collaborer étroitement avec les parties prenantes internes, les LRR et les RPR pour soutenir les approbations en temps opportun et la conformité réglementaire. - Établir et entretenir des relations solides avec les autorités sanitaires régionales grâce à une communication efficace et une documentation de haute qualité. - Restez informé de la législation réglementaire internationale, des lignes directrices et des développements de l'industrie pertinents pour les produits et activités de CSL. - Évaluer l'impact de l'évolution des réglementations locales et régionales et fournir des évaluations des risques réglementaires. - Soutenir les initiatives d'amélioration continue pour améliorer les processus réglementaires, la conformité et l'excellence opérationnelle.
• Qualifications et expérience Éducation - Diplôme en sciences biologiques, en sciences médicales, en pharmacie ou dans un domaine connexe. - Des diplômes de troisième cycle ou une spécialisation en affaires réglementaires pharmaceutiques sont considérés comme un avantage. Expérience - Minimum 5 ans d'expérience en affaires réglementaires sur les marchés internationaux. - Une expérience supplémentaire dans l'industrie pharmaceutique ou biotechnologique est hautement souhaitable. Aptitudes et compétences - Un anglais courant est requis. - Des langues supplémentaires sont considérées comme un atout (par exemple, arabe, français, espagnol, russe). - Forte compréhension du développement de produits pharmaceutiques et des exigences réglementaires. - Connaissance des principes GMP et GCP. - Excellentes compétences en communication, en gestion des parties prenantes et en organisation. - Capacité à travailler efficacement dans un environnement global et interfonctionnel. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Il s’agit d’une opportunité unique de contribuer à la fourniture de thérapies qui changent la vie des patients du monde entier, tout en travaillant dans un environnement mondial collaboratif et innovant. Chez CSL, nous nous engageons à l’amélioration continue, à l’excellence scientifique et à faire une différence significative dans la vie des patients. À propos de CSL Behring CSL Behring est un leader mondial des biothérapeutiques animé par notre promesse de sauver des vies. Axés sur la satisfaction des besoins des patients en utilisant les dernières technologies, nous découvrons, développons et proposons des thérapies innovantes pour les personnes vivant avec des maladies dans les domaines thérapeutiques de l’immunologie, de l’hématologie, des maladies cardiovasculaires et métaboliques, respiratoires et de transplantation. Nous utilisons trois plates-formes scientifiques stratégiques de fractionnement du plasma, de technologie des protéines recombinantes et de thérapie cellulaire et génique pour soutenir l'innovation continue.
